jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Product Management - Bilingual English/Spanish
jobs.desc:
Requisition ID: 267695

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Senior Manager, Data Product Management, has a key role in the Global Wealth Management (GWM) Data Centre of Excellence. Reporting to the Director, Data Product Management, this role is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of data products. The Senior Manager will work closely with business stakeholders, technology partners, and data stewards to define, develop, and deliver high-quality data products that drive business value and align with GWM's data strategy. This role is pivotal in fostering an insight-driven culture and ensuring that data is leveraged as a strategic asset across the organization.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Manage the entire data product lifecycle from ideation, through development and testing, to launch, and iteration
Be responsible for the strategic vision around enabling enterprise-scale AI through trusted, governed, interoperable, and reusable data products that transform data into intelligent business outcomes
Contribute to the data product roadmap, prioritize features, and define product requirements based on business needs and user feedback
Champion data governance and ensure data products adhere to all policies, standards, and quality metrics.
Work with Data Stewards to define and document metadata, data lineage, and quality controls for data products
Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for data products, including usage, quality, and business value
Collaborate with business lines, technology teams, and the Chief Data Office (CDO) to ensure alignment of data strategies, standards, and governance
Act as a key liaison between technical teams and business users to translate business needs into technical requirements and vice versa
Foster cross-functional collaboration to ensure efficient data access and management
Identify new opportunities to create business value through the development of innovative data products
Support the strategic, use-case-based approach to growing data product capabilities and maturing GWM's data practice

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? – We’d love to work with you if you have:

Undergraduate degree in technology, commerce, or a related field
Spanish language skills are mandatory due to regular interactions with Spanish-speaking clients and stakeholders
Strong knowledge of industry standards, trends in data products, data quality, data storage and distribution solutions, data governance, and product ownership
Excellent negotiation skills when communicating with business and technical stakeholders and aligning needs, capabilities, and technology.
Proven experience managing the end-to-end product lifecycle for data-intensive products
Strong knowledge of the Wealth Management or Financial Services industry is required
Experience with data management tools and query languages (e.g., SQL, Python)
Familiarity with data analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Looker).
Knowledge of modern data platforms and cloud environments (e.g., GCP, Azure, Databricks) is an asset
Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills
Strong ability to explain complex data concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Creative, self-starting, and results-oriented with a strong ability to solve complex problems
Proven ability to balance strategic vision with practical, hands-on execution

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Data Governance Consultant, Senior Associate
jobs.desc:
At PwC, our people in infrastructure focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations. They enable the smooth functioning of networks, servers, and data centres to optimise performance and minimise downtime. In infrastructure engineering at PwC, you will focus on designing and implementing robust and scalable technology infrastructure solutions for clients. Your work will involve network architecture, server management, and cloud computing experience.
The Opportunity

As a Data Governance Consultant, Senior Associate, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. We are seeking a Data Governance Consultant to support a client in the banking / financial services sector on a cloud migration program. This individual will be embedded directly within the client team and will play a key role in supporting data governance across a multi-wave migration from on-premises environments to Azure.

The consultant will help ensure that data governance considerations are incorporated into migration planning, implementation, go-live, and post-go-live enforcement. In addition to core data governance responsibilities, the ideal candidate should also be able to support broader advisory-type activities, including business analysis, migration readiness assessment, workshop facilitation, and cross-functional coordination. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to:

Support the definition and implementation of data governance frameworks, principles, policies, standards, and controls for a cloud migration program

Help establish and refine data ownership, stewardship, and governance operating models

Assess applications and data domains for cloud migration readiness, including governance, classification, quality, lineage, retention, privacy, and control implications

Ensure data governance requirements are considered and embedded across migration planning, implementation, testing, go-live, and post-go-live operations

Facilitate collaboration across business, risk, governance, and technology teams to support effective implementation and adoption of governance practices

Support data classification, retention, usage, access, and control requirements in alignment with regulatory and enterprise standards

Help identify and define data quality expectations, governance checkpoints, and monitoring requirements

Contribute to metadata, catalog, and lineage-related requirements where relevant to migration activities

Create governance-related deliverables as needed, including frameworks, assessments, process documentation, RACI models, standards, risk considerations, and executive/readout materials

Gather and document business and stakeholder requirements; facilitate workshops; document current and future state processes; and translate business needs into governance and process requirements

Support issue, risk, dependency, and action tracking across governance-related workstreams

Provide practical advisory support to help teams make informed decisions in a regulated cloud migration environment

What You'll Bring
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:

3–5 years of overall professional experience

1–2+ years of direct data governance experience

Experience supporting data governance in cloud migration, cloud transformation, or data transformation programs

Consulting and/or advisory experience in a client-facing environment

Strong understanding of core data governance concepts, including governance frameworks, operating models, stewardship, ownership, policies, standards, and controls

Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement

Experience assessing governance implications across application and data migration scenarios

Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to work across business and technology teams

Experience working in a regulated environment; banking / financial services experience is an asset

Ability to work in a hybrid model in the GTA, with 2–3 days onsite

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting cloud migration to Azure

Exposure to migration scenarios involving applications and databases such as Oracle, MySQL, and similar platforms

Experience supporting hybrid-state migrations, where applications and data may transition at different times

Hands-on experience with or exposure to governance / risk / metadata tools such as:

IBM OpenPages

IKC

Microsoft Purview

Familiarity with governance considerations related to data quality, metadata, lineage, privacy, retention, and regulatory compliance

Banking or broader financial services experience is preferred but not required

Core Skills / Competencies

Data governance and operating model knowledge

Cloud migration governance

Business analysis and requirements gathering

Workshop facilitation

Stakeholder management

Structured problem solving

Executive and working-team communication

Ability to influence across teams without direct authority

Coordination across business, risk, and technology functions

This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.

The salary range for this position is $84,700 - $134,700. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc

jobs.title: Data Senior Engineer - Data Modernization & Archiving - Remote
jobs.desc:
Req ID: 388396

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Data Senior Engineer - Data Modernization Archiving - Remote to join our team in Toronto, Ontario (CA-ON), Canada (CA).



Senior Developer – Data Modernization Archiving



Project Overview

We are seeking Senior Developers to support a data modernization and archiving initiative involving the migration of historical financial data from a legacy UNISYS mainframe environment to a secure, scalable, and user-friendly archival solution.

The successful candidates will bring strong experience in Microsoft Power BI, Oracle PL/SQL, and ETL development, with a proven ability to work across data analysis, data modelling, migration, business intelligence, reporting, validation, testing, integration, and deployment.

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, the Senior Developers will help design and implement solutions that meet requirements for data quality, reporting, performance, governance, and long-term data retention.



Key Responsibilities
• Gather, analyze, validate, and translate business and technical requirements into functional and technical specifications.
• Analyze legacy and source-system data and develop data models, mappings, business rules, and data structures.
• Design, develop, and maintain Oracle PL/SQL and ETL processes supporting data migration, transformation, and archival.
• Design, develop, and enhance Microsoft Power BI dashboards, reports, datasets, and visualizations.
• Develop business intelligence and ad-hoc reporting solutions to support business and operational requirements.
• Integrate reporting and data solutions with existing applications, databases, and other data sources.
• Develop data validation, reconciliation, error-handling, and quality assurance processes to ensure data integrity.
• Perform unit testing, data validation, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and defect resolution.
• Support reporting integrations, APIs, embedded analytics, and related data services as required.
• Collaborate with business, technical, and data stakeholders to address data quality, governance, reporting, and retention requirements.
• Participate in stakeholder workshops to understand business objectives, KPIs, reporting requirements, and success criteria.
• Prepare and maintain technical and functional documentation, including architecture, data mappings, workflows, technical specifications, and support procedures.
• Support solution deployment, production implementation, release activities, and post-deployment support.
• Provide user training, knowledge transfer, and transition-to-support activities.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of data, reporting, migration, and archival processes.



Required Qualifications
• 8+ years of experience in software development, data engineering, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
• 5+ years of experience working as a Senior Software Developer, Senior Programmer, or in a comparable senior technical role.
• 5+ years of experience with data analysis, data modelling, data mapping, and integration of multiple data sources.
• 2+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle PL/SQL and ETL development.
• 2+ years of experience developing business intelligence reports, dashboards, datasets, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI.
• 2+ years of experience designing or implementing data migration and/or archival solutions, including data validation, reconciliation, quality assurance, testing, and troubleshooting.
• Experience working with complex or legacy data environments and transforming historical data into modern reporting or archival solutions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.



Additional Requirements
• Must currently hold a valid Government of Canada Reliability Status security clearance.
• Must be fluent in English, including reading, writing, and speaking. French bilingualism is considered an asset.
• Must possess a University Degree or College/CEGEP Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized post-secondary institution. Proof of education must be provided upon request.



Pay Transparency

Where required by law, NTT DATA provides a reasonable range of compensation for specific roles. The starting pay range for this remote role is $ $75,570-$132,660 This range reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Actual compensation will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s actual work location, relevant experience, technical skills, and other qualifications.

This position is eligible for company benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance with an employer contribution, flexible spending or health savings account, life and ADD insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program with company match, and additional voluntary or legally-required benefits.



About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.



Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

Accelerate your success at Colliers.

Why Colliers?

As one of Canada’s leading commercial real estate services firms, we are driven by our mission to accelerate success for our people, clients, and communities.

A career at Colliers gives you the opportunity to make an impact, advance your career, and collaborate with top-tier talent. ***This is a Building Operator role for Royal Bank Plaza in downtown Toronto***

About the role

The incumbent will be responsible for providing critical thinking and effective Technical Services, Support, and maintaining Uptime for all Critical Systems supporting the TRDC Data Centre at Royal Bank Plaza.

Responsible for the Operation of the Control Centre, UPS, BAS, Plant Mechanical, Water Treatment, Fire Alarm, Electrical, and EPGS Systems for the TRDC Critical Systems.

Responsible for the daily monitoring, inspections/daily rounds, recording of data and maintaining all Critical Systems for the TRDC.

Thoroughly understand all SOP’s and EOP’s pertaining to the Critical Systems of the TRDC.

Be familiar with escalating Critical Events to the Technical Operations Manager and be able to action SOPs/EOPs in emergency and disaster recovery situations.

Perform immediate, effective procedures to rectify anomalies in Day-to-Day operations, including temperature/setpoint adjustments, mode switching for cooling, and EPGS monthly testing.

Provide exemplary customer service to Capital Markets Trading Floor staff.

Monitor and utilize Building Automation System (Ainsworth/Schneider) to ensure optimal operating parameters and energy efficiency.

Comfort and familiarity in Electrical Breaker Switching procedures and opening and closing breakers using proper PPE.

The successful incumbent is required to work a rotating 42-hour shift (Continental), consisting of Daytime (D12), Nighttime (N12), and weekend shifts (D12/N12), to perform their required duties.

As required, support colleagues by covering open shifts due to illness or vacation. Some after-hours Critical Activities may require more than 1 operator, for which overtime will be paid.

Ability to work with others and independently to perform their duties.

Ability to read blueprints and understand Single Line Diagrams for TRDC.

Ability to communicate with clarity via email and ability to present documents using Microsoft Word and Excel.

Must always be alert during daytime, nighttime and weekend shifts and respond immediately as required.

Be motivated and a self-starter to complete work assigned by required deadlines.

Ability to work well under pressure, utilizing their knowledge to make proper decisions to maintain 100% UPTIME.

Good interpersonal skills, allowing the candidate to work well with others, including colleagues, contractors, and all staff at Royal Bank Plaza.

2 - 5 Years of experience in a Data Centre environment.

BES 1&2 or 4th Class Power Engineer certificate

jobs.title: AI & Data Utilities Leader
jobs.desc:
We Are:

Accenture Data & AI — the people who love using data to tell a story. We're the world's largest team of data scientists and experts in machine learning and AI. A great day for us means solving big problems using the latest tech, serious brain power, and deep knowledge of just about every industry. We believe a mix of data, analytics, automation, and responsible AI can do almost anything — spark digital reinvention, widen the range of what humans can do, and breathe life into smart products and services.

In the Public Sector, we partner with government agencies, crown corporations, and public institutions to drive meaningful, citizen-centred transformation. We bring the full depth of Accenture's AI and data capabilities to solve complex challenges that matter at a societal scale.

You Are: A thought leader and practitioner at the intersection of AI strategy and data delivery — As a senior leader in the Data & AI practice, you will coach and mentor up-and-coming leaders, guide diverse multi-disciplinary teams, and help clients embed AI and data capabilities as a lasting part of their organisational culture — with a strong focus on responsible AI, data governance, and public trust.

Role Summary

As a Senior Leader in Accenture’s Data &AI practice, you will lead the strategy, design, and scaled delivery of AI & Data solutions for Utilities industry and clients. You will build reusable data/AI capabilities—covering ingestion, orchestration, governance, data products, analytics enablement, and model/AI lifecycle—so clients can accelerate time-to-value while meeting enterprise-grade requirements for security, privacy, quality, and responsible AI. The Utilities industry is at the center of the largest infrastructure transformation in a generation—the collision of decarbonization, unprecedented load growth from electrification and data centers, grid resilience against extreme weather events, affordability and regulatory pressure, and the shift to distributed, digitized, AI-enabled operations. You will own the Data & AI agenda for our Utilities portfolio across Canada, personally leading the most consequential CxO relationships, and set the pace for how the portfolio grows, delivers and shows up in the market.

Key Responsibilities

Set direction for AI & Data Utilities: Own the target-state vision, architecture, and roadmap for data/AI utilities across complex enterprise landscapes (multiple systems, domains, and stakeholders).

Lead large-scale client engagements: Drive end-to-end delivery leadership across strategy, design, build, and transition-to-run, ensuring outcomes and adoption.

Operationalize reusable accelerators: Establish standards and scalable patterns (reference architectures, reusable pipelines, governance workflows, data product frameworks, and MLOps/LLMOps practices).

Governance & responsible AI leadership: Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, access controls, privacy/security-by-design, and responsible AI practices are embedded into utility capabilities.

Client & executive stakeholder management: Lead executive communications, manage relationships with CIO/CTO/CDAO/Operations leadership, and align delivery to business outcomes and enterprise priorities.

People leadership & talent development: Lead and mentor multi-disciplinary teams (architecture, engineering, data operations, analytics/AI, delivery), ensuring strong delivery rigor and continuous improvement.

Commercial ownership and growth support: Contribute to proposal development, shape solution approaches, estimate effort, and support expansion within industry/enterprise accounts.

Delivery governance: Ensure quality, risk management, and delivery health across workstreams; manage dependencies, budgets (where applicable), and escalations.

Shape the Utilities Data & AI agenda: own the industry point of view and go-to-market, including energy-transition advisory, rate case and regulatory environment, OT/IT convergence, grid-modernization and DERMS-enabling data platforms, wildfire and resilience analytics, customer-experience transformation and AI-enabled workforce and field operations. Represent Accenture externally with clients, alliance partners, regulators and industry bodies.

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, business administration, commerce, or engineering

12+ years of relevant experience in enterprise data platforms and/or AI/ML engineering, including architecture and operationalization.

Proven track record of building and growing an industry portfolio – origination, sales and expansion – with personally attributable multi-$MM record in annual originated sales and ownership of multi-$MM in managed revenue at portfolio scale, sustained across multiple years and through all least one full economic or industry cycle.

Recognized trusted advisor to C-suite and Board-level executives at large enterprise Utility industry clients, with the credibility and presence to lead the most challenging conversations on strategy, investment, and transformation outcomes in a rapidly changing Utilities landscape.

Demonstrated experience leading large, multi-year transformation programs with measurable outcomes (platform adoption, performance improvement, reduced time-to-insight, improved operational efficiency, etc.).

Strong background in enterprise data architecture and delivery for utility-style platforms (integration, orchestration, data products, governance, and data operations).

Proven leadership in MLOps/LLMOps and lifecycle management (deployment, monitoring, evaluation, governance, and continual improvement).

Deep understanding of data governance (quality, lineage, catalog, access controls) and responsible AI (risk controls, evaluation, auditability, transparency principles).

Strong experience in stakeholder and executive management and ability to translate technical strategy into business value.

Track record of building, leading & developing high-performance teams at scale and influencing without authority across client organizations and internal leadership.

Recognized eminence and thought leadership in Data & AI for Utilities – evidenced by such recurring keynote or mainstage presence at flagship industry forums (e.g. DistribuTECH, CERAWeek, Enlit, WEF Energy), published points of view carried by tier-one industry or business media in the last 24 months, and standing relationships with the leading Utilities in Canada as well as AI/Data analysts (Gartner, Forrester, Wood Mackenzie, S&P Global).

Skills & Experience (Preferred)

Familiarity with industrial/enterprise contexts aligned to I&E (manufacturing, industrial operations, industrial IoT/data, maintenance & reliability analytics, supply chain/asset performance).

Direct senior-client experience across at least two of: North American Utilities & Power companies, European integrated utilities and network operators, and Asia-Pacific power, water or renewables majors.

Experience with cloud-based data and AI platforms (e.g., Azure/AWS/GCP), data engineering frameworks, CI/CD, observability, and automation practices.

Experience delivering batch + streaming data solutions and integrating enterprise systems (ETL/ELT, APIs, event streaming, integration frameworks).

Hands-on or strong working knowledge of data/AI tooling for orchestration, feature/data management, and governance workflows.

May require travel depending on client needs (industry/enterprise engagements).

Combination of client collaboration and remote delivery.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Team Lead, MEP
jobs.desc:
Company Description

Are you ambitious and looking to make the right move in your career? Now is the perfect time to join Egis. We are now over 21,000 engineers, architects, scientists and planners across the world and experiencing substantial growth in North America. This strategic move underscores our commitment to investing in North America, propelling our expansion to new heights.

Job Description

Egis is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer – Team Lead, MEP to lead and grow our electrical building-services capability in Canada.

This is a senior technical and leadership role combining electrical engineering, project delivery, client engagement, team leadership and business development. The successful candidate will provide leadership for the design and delivery of electrical systems for commercial, institutional, transportation, aviation and other building and facility projects.

The Team Lead will work closely with mechanical, architectural, structural, civil and other engineering disciplines to deliver integrated MEP solutions. The role will also support the continued growth of Egis's electrical practice by developing staff, strengthening technical standards and quality processes, supporting proposals and pursuing new project opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a technically strong Professional Engineer with significant Canadian MEP/building electrical design experience who is comfortable leading both people and projects.

Team Leadership

Provide day-to-day technical and people leadership to electrical engineers, designers and BIM staff supporting MEP projects.
Support resource planning, workload management and allocation of electrical staff across projects.
Mentor and develop junior and intermediate engineers and designers.
Support employee development through technical coaching, knowledge sharing and regular feedback.
Establish clear expectations for technical quality, project delivery and accountability.
Promote collaboration between the MEP electrical team and Egis's broader Electrical, Mechanical and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Support recruitment and onboarding as the MEP electrical team continues to grow.

Technical Leadership and Project Delivery

Lead the planning, design and delivery of electrical systems for MEP and building projects from concept through detailed design, construction and commissioning.
Lead electrical design activities including power distribution, service and utility coordination, transformers, switchgear, panelboards, emergency and standby power systems, UPS systems and associated electrical infrastructure.
Lead the design of lighting and lighting controls, emergency lighting, receptacle and small-power systems, grounding and bonding, lightning protection and other building electrical systems.
Provide technical leadership for fire alarm, communications, security and other low-voltage/ELV systems, as applicable to project scope.
Prepare and review electrical load calculations, equipment sizing, cable and feeder sizing, voltage-drop calculations, short-circuit and coordination studies and other electrical engineering calculations.
Develop and review single-line diagrams, electrical layouts, equipment schedules, specifications, reports, tender documents and construction packages.
Perform technical and QA/QC reviews of electrical engineering deliverables.
Ensure designs comply with the Canadian Electrical Code, applicable provincial building and fire codes, client standards and other relevant codes and industry requirements.
Support projects during tender, construction, testing, commissioning and handover, including review of shop drawings, RFIs, change requests and field conditions.
Participate in site investigations, field reviews and construction-phase engineering support.

MEP and Multidisciplinary Coordination

Coordinate electrical designs with mechanical, architectural, structural, civil and other engineering disciplines.
Work closely with mechanical teams on HVAC equipment power requirements, controls interfaces, equipment locations and electrical infrastructure requirements.
Lead electrical BIM coordination and support integrated multidisciplinary design using Revit and other digital design tools.
Identify and resolve multidisciplinary design conflicts and constructability issues.
Participate in design coordination meetings, technical workshops and client reviews.

Quality and Technical Standards

Champion engineering quality and consistent application of Egis QA/QC processes.
Develop and maintain electrical design standards, calculation templates, specifications, typical details, BIM standards and other technical tools.
Support continuous improvement of engineering workflows and project delivery practices.
Promote lessons learned and knowledge sharing across projects and teams.
Maintain awareness of evolving codes, technologies, sustainability requirements and industry best practices.

Client and Business Development

Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, architects, contractors and project partners.
Participate in client meetings and provide senior technical representation for Egis.
Support preparation of proposals, scopes of work, fee estimates and project execution plans.
Assist with identifying and pursuing new MEP and building-services opportunities.
Provide technical input to pursuits, interviews and presentations.
Support the continued growth of Egis's MEP electrical practice and broader multidisciplinary building-services offering in Canada.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation in good standing with a Canadian engineering regulator, or eligibility for registration in the applicable province.
Minimum 10 years of progressive electrical engineering experience, with significant experience in MEP/building electrical design.
Minimum 5 years of Canadian consulting engineering experience involving building electrical systems and multidisciplinary project delivery.
Demonstrated experience leading electrical design teams and managing electrical engineering deliverables.
Strong knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC) and applicable building, fire and electrical standards.
Strong experience with building power distribution, lighting, emergency power, grounding and associated electrical systems.
Demonstrated experience delivering projects from concept and detailed design through construction and commissioning.
Experience coordinating electrical designs with mechanical, architectural, structural and other disciplines.
Strong technical writing, communication and interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineering and design staff.
Strong client-facing and project-management capabilities.

Preferred / Assets

Experience with Revit MEP and BIM-based project delivery.
Experience with AutoCAD and electrical engineering/design software.
Experience with ETAP, AGi32, ElumTools or similar electrical analysis and lighting-design software.
Experience with fire alarm, communications, security and other building low-voltage systems.
Experience delivering electrical systems for one or more of the following sectors:
Commercial and mixed-use developments
Institutional and educational facilities
Healthcare facilities
Transportation facilities
Airports and aviation facilities
Industrial facilities
Data centres or mission-critical facilities
Experience with sustainable and energy-efficient building design, electrification, EV charging, renewable energy or low-carbon building strategies.
Experience supporting proposals, fee development and business development.
Previous formal team-lead or people-management experience within a multidisciplinary engineering consulting environment.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can help build a team and a capability, not simply deliver individual projects.

The successful candidate will combine strong electrical engineering fundamentals with practical MEP design experience, sound engineering judgment and an ability to lead people. They will be comfortable working directly with clients and multidisciplinary project teams while maintaining accountability for technical quality, schedule and project delivery.

The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys mentoring others, solving complex multidisciplinary design challenges and helping grow a building-services practice.

Additional Information

Egis Canada is an equal opportunities employer offering a competitive salary and benefits to those with the skills suited to the needs of our clients. The salary range advertised may exceed the range based on several factors, including relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

This role is eligible for a referral bonus in line with the Referral Program. If you have been referred, please provide the name of the employee who has referred you at the time of your application.

At Egis, we embrace innovation to tackle challenges and utilize AI in our recruitment process under stringent ethics and compliance policies and in alignment with our values of being a Responsible Company, a People First Company and a Creative Company. Committed to diversity, growth and collaboration, we may leverage AI to support the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Designer - 2027 New Graduate Rotational Program
jobs.desc:
OUR PURPOSE

At HH Angus, we strive to expand what is possible to shape a better future. We do this by empowering our employees to do their best work, find meaning in what they do and provide opportunities to grow. As an independent consulting firm with over 450 employees, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for our clients’ most complex challenges. Our passion is solving problems, innovation is our culture, sustainability is in our DNA, and we thrive on our clients’ success.

MAKE AN IMPACT THAT MATTERS

We’re looking to hire permanent, full-time, forward-thinking electrical engineering graduates to join our 2027 New Graduate Rotational Program and help us take on some of the most complex engineering challenges in Canada and beyond.

This is your opportunity to be part of an outstanding team known for pushing the boundaries of electrical engineering design. From healthcare and commercial buildings to large-scale data centres and transportation hubs, our projects shape communities and set new industry standards. Many of our most successful engineers started right here — as motivated, curious problem-solvers eager to make an impact.

Through formal mentorship, extensive training, and hands-on experience across multiple disciplines, our rotational program is designed to accelerate your growth. You’ll gain exposure to the full project lifecycle — from concept and design to construction and commissioning — while working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. With 100+ years of history, HH Angus continues to thrive because of our culture of innovation, client service, and technical excellence.

At HH Angus, we’re serious about professional development, but we also value balance and fun. Our culture is built on collaboration, social connection, and giving back — whether through team events, community outreach, or our year-round half-day Fridays. With one of the lowest turnover rates in the industry, we’re proud that people choose to build their careers with us.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

4-year University Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent program (graduating 2027).
Familiarity with AutoCAD and Revit is an asset.
Forward-thinking, eager to learn best practices and contribute innovative ideas.
Strong accuracy, documentation, and organizational skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively in multi-disciplinary teams.
Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and drive to broaden your technical expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Prepares drawings, designs, and calculations for engineering projects and assignments of low complexity.
Assesses design constructability and makes edits to existing design specifications with support and guidance from more senior engineers.
Delivers all assigned tasks on a timely basis meeting project deadlines.
Assist in developing standards and reports with support and guidance from more senior engineers.
Effectively applies tools and methodologies used for product and service delivery (e.g., AutoCAD, HHA Drawing Standards, Plotters, etc.).
Ensures timesheets, logs, and files are accurate and up to date.
Works under the supervision of a more senior engineer in solving problems.
Other duties as required.

WHY HH ANGUS

Hybrid and flexible work options.
Defined career path and mentorship support.
Meaningful projects with real-world impact.
Comprehensive benefits, wellness programs, and professional development.
Inclusive, collaborative culture where your voice matters.
Exclusive New Grad Rotational Program – accelerate your engineering career by exploring high-impact building sectors with dedicated professional mentorship.

TOTAL REWARDS

The expected salary for this role is between $65,000 to $72,000 annually. Base salaries are determined considering several factors such as skills and competencies, experience, education, and internal and external competitiveness. Along with your base salary we offer a wide array of programs that include our Short Term Incentive bonus program, technical and business training, mentoring, wellness initiatives, the opportunity to participate in our coveted Defined Benefit Pension plan, flexible work arrangement, and hybrid work structure.

ARE YOU READY TO EXPAND WHAT IS POSSIBLE?

If this sounds like the right place to launch your career, we want to hear from you. Please send your résumé and cover letter to https://hhangus.com/job-listings-students/ (https://hhangus.com/job-listings-students/)

HH Angus is committed to providing an accessible work environment. Upon request during the recruitment process, HH Angus will accommodate applicants with disabilities. For more information on our Accessibility Program please refer to our Accessibility Policy.

We thank all candidates for their interest, but only qualified candidates will be contacted. We are an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.desc: About YondrYondr is a disruptor. We challenge convention and simplify complexity. A global developer, owner operator and service provider of data centers, we deliver complex data center capacity needs for the world’s largest tech companies. Our exponential growth sees us looking for extraordinary people to help accelerate us towards our vision: a tomorrow without constraints. But we can’t do this without you. The RoleThe Critical Facility Shift Technician is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of mission-critical infrastructure within the data center. This role covers all aspects of energy isolation, switch activity, and facility rounds, ensuring compliance with safety standards and operational procedures. The Critical Facility Technician reports directly to the Critical Facility Shift Manager and works as part of a larger team that strives for excellence through teamwork and accountability. This is a shift-based role requiring flexibility to work nights, weekends, and holidays as part of a 24/7 operations team. Main responsibilitiesOperations & Rounds Conduct scheduled and unscheduled facility rounds, inspecting all critical systems (electrical, mechanical, HVAC, fire/life safety, and security) for proper operation and signs of abnormality. Monitor Building Management System (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS), and other automation platforms for alarms and alerts; respond promptly per SOPs. Maintain accurate logs of alarms, operational events, isolations, and shift activities. Ensure all Statuory PPM workorders are completed ontime and any resulting actions are logged and tracked and remediated in good time. Ensure all Yondr self delivered works are covered by acurate and relevant risk and method statements. Confirm that all contractor RAMS are accurate before the work tasks start. Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance tasks as assigned. Energy Isolation & Switch Activity Execute all energy isolation procedures, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), in accordance with company policy and regulatory requirements. Perform and document all switchgear operations, including breaker racking, transfer switches, and panel isolations. Verify isolation and de-energization prior to work; ensure proper signage, barricading, and communication. Coordinate with vendors and other teams for planned and emergency isolations. Maintain records of all isolation activities, including authorization, verification, and restoration. Incident Response & Troubleshooting Respond to alarms, system notifications, and abnormal conditions; perform initial diagnostics and escalate as needed. Support incident response efforts, including root cause analysis and after-action reporting. Participate in emergency procedures, including system recovery and safe shutdowns. Compliance & Documentation Adhere to all safety, environmental, and regulatory standards. Ensure all work is performed per approved Method of Procedure (MOP), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), and Emergency Operating Procedure (EOP). Maintain up-to-date documentation for rounds, isolations, switch activities, and maintenance tasks. Continuous Improvement & Teamwork Identify opportunities for operational improvement and risk reduction. Participate in training and periodic program reviews. Support development and review of procedures and playbooks. Collaborate closely with team members, sharing knowledge and supporting a culture of accountability and mutual respect. Ensure the Yondr brand is maintained as a first class operator with all vcisitors and contractors. Qualifications and experienceHigh school diploma or equivalent required; technical certification (electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or related field) preferred. 2+ years of experience in mission-critical environments (data center, hospital, industrial plant, etc.). Demonstrated experience with energy isolation, LOTO, and switchgear operations. Technical Skills Strong understanding of electrical and mechanical systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs, CRAC/CRAH units, and fire/life safety systems. Proficiency in BMS/EPMS platforms and alarm management. Ability to read and interpret one-line diagrams, MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs. Safety & Compliance Knowledge of OSHA, NFPA 70E, and other relevant safety standards. Experience performing LOTO and energy isolation in accordance with regulatory and company requirements. Other Requirements Excellent communication and documentation skills. Ability to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required. Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Strong teamwork and accountability mindset.  At Yondr, we want to enhance the diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging of our workforce to reflect the world we live in. Our roles are potential opportunities for everyone; all interested parties, regardless of nationality, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, or gender, are welcome to apply. We ensure all candidates have equitable access and consideration throughout the hiring process.  Yondr is committed to fostering a welcoming, safe and inclusive work environment. We provide support through our benefits, which are inclusive of all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Data Center Delivery (DCD) Sub-Regional Construction Leader
jobs.desc:
Overview

Cloud Operations + Innovation (CO+I) is the team behind Microsoft’s cloud platform and is responsible for delivering the infrastructure that powers our customers and services worldwide.

The Datacenter Construction Delivery (DCD) organization is responsible for delivering datacenter capacity that supports Microsoft's cloud business while meeting safety, quality, sustainability, schedule, budget, and operational readiness requirements.

The DCD Sub-Regional Construction Leader provides leadership, ownership, and accountability for the safe, predictable, and efficient delivery of large-scale datacenter construction programs across an assigned sub-region. This role is responsible for leading construction teams and delivery partners to achieve safety, quality, scope, schedule, budget, and operational readiness objectives in support of Microsoft's cloud growth strategy.

The DCD Sub-Regional Construction Leader establishes portfolio priorities, allocates resources, drives risk management and governance, and promotes consistency in execution across campuses and projects. This role partners with Engineering, Supply Chain, Contracts, Project Controls, Commissioning, Quality, Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), Operations, and external delivery partners to ensure successful project delivery and continuous improvement.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Employees come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize shared goals. We build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership, ownership, and accountability for the safe, predictable, and efficient delivery of large-scale datacenter construction programs across the assigned sub-region.
Champion a culture of safety and ensure compliance with Microsoft Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements, organizational standards, and industry best practices.
Lead construction teams and delivery partners to achieve portfolio objectives related to safety, quality, scope, schedule, budget, and operational readiness.
Establish portfolio priorities and allocate resources to support business needs, project complexity, and delivery commitments.
Develop and maintain reporting processes that provide visibility into portfolio performance, risks, trends, and key business outcomes.
Lead project risk identification, mitigation planning, issue escalation, and governance processes across the sub-region.
Drive construction readiness activities including project planning, resource deployment, constructability reviews, execution planning, and delivery strategy alignment.
Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Contracts, Project Controls, Commissioning, Quality, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure integrated project delivery.
Influence and coach internal and external partners to resolve complex issues, remove barriers, and improve project outcomes.
Provide leadership oversight of contractors, consultants, suppliers, and other delivery partners to ensure contractual compliance and performance expectations are achieved.
Oversee project controls, commercial governance, budget management, forecasting, change management, and financial reporting activities.
Conduct regular site visits to assess project status, reinforce expectations, identify emerging risks, and support project teams.
Lead portfolio review processes to evaluate project performance, risk profiles, mitigation plans, and delivery confidence.
Sponsor root cause analyses, lessons learned, and corrective actions to drive continuous improvement across the portfolio.
Establish performance metrics, dashboards, and scorecards that promote accountability and support data-driven decision making.
Ensure project teams are prepared for commissioning, operational turnover, project closeout, and transition to operations.
Build organizational capability through workforce planning, succession planning, talent development, mentorship, and leadership coaching.
Model Microsoft values and foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Embody our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 12+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 15+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.
15+ years experience working on data center projects.
10+ years project management experience.
10+ years people management experience.
Proven safety leader with a demonstrated ability to build and sustain a culture of physical safety, psychological safety, and employee well-being.
Experience leading large-scale capital construction programs with accountability for safety, quality, scope, schedule, cost, and business outcomes.
Experience leading geographically distributed construction organizations across multiple campuses, metros, regions, or countries.
Demonstrated success building, developing, and leading high-performing teams through talent development, succession planning, organizational growth, and change management.
Strong cross-functional leader with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across Construction, Engineering, Supply Chain, Contracts, Project Controls, Commissioning, Quality, Operations, and external partners.
Experience establishing portfolio governance, risk management, performance reporting, and executive communication processes across multiple concurrent projects.
Strong commercial acumen with experience in contracting strategy, vendor performance management, change management, cost control, and claims avoidance.
Experience delivering complex, first-of-kind, accelerated, or high-risk projects while maintaining predictable business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to use data, metrics, and business insights to drive decisions, improve performance, and influence senior stakeholders.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical, commercial, and operational issues into clear business decisions and actionable outcomes.
Professional certifications such as DBIA, PMP, CCM, PE, LEED, CQM, or equivalent industry credentials.

jobs.title: Junior IT Infrastructure Technician
jobs.desc: About SyncSync is a Canadian company building zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted cloud storage and collaboration for over two million people and businesses worldwide. Unlike most of our competitors, we own and operate our own storage infrastructure rather than renting it. Our customers’ data lives on our hardware, in our racks, in Canada. That is a core part of our product promise, and it means the physical infrastructure is not a back-office concern here. It is the product.About The RoleWe are hiring a Junior IT Infrastructure Technician to help maintain the JBODs, servers, and network gear in our Toronto colocation facility. This is a hybrid role based in Toronto, with regular travel to our Toronto Data Centre required to do hands-on work, and a genuinely strong entry point into storage and infrastructure engineering, you will be working directly on petabyte-scale storage systems from your first week.You will rack and maintain hardware, replace failed drives and components, own the RMA process end to end, manage procurement, and support the day-to-day IT needs of the team. We are looking for someone early in their career who is curious about how things work and who moves toward problems instead of waiting to be assigned them. You will not be expected to arrive knowing everything. You will be expected to ask good questions, document what you learn, and take real ownership of the things you touch. Once you're ramped up, this role will also include participation in an on-call rotation.What You Will DoMaintain our JBOD storage enclosures: identify and replace failed drives, verify rebuilds complete cleanly, and track drive health and failure trends over timeInstall, cable, configure, provision and decommission servers and storage chassis in our Toronto colocation cageDiagnose and resolve hardware faults across drives, memory, PSUs, HBAs, SAS expanders, backplanes, and network componentsSupport network infrastructure: rack and cable switches, maintain accurate port maps, and assist with configuration changes under supervisionSupport the team during critical situations: respond to monitoring alerts, work the relevant runbook, and help recover systems from unexpected failuresOwn the RMA process end to end: identify the failure, open the case with the vendor, track the shipment, install the replacement, and confirm the fix. Then make sure the inventory reflects realityManage procurement for hardware and IT equipment, including quoting, purchase orders, receiving, and day-to-day vendor communicationMaintain an accurate asset inventory covering serial numbers, warranty status, rack and slot locations, and lifecycle stateKeep the cage clean and auditable through disciplined structured cabling, labelling, and cable managementHandle media sanitization and secure disposal of decommissioned drives in line with our security policiesCoordinate with the colocation provider on remote hands, access approvals, power and cooling questions, and scheduled maintenance windowsProvide general IT support to internal staff, including laptop provisioning, account setup, and endpoint troubleshootingWrite and improve runbooks so the next person can do the task without having to askParticipate in an on-call rotation for incidents after an onboarding period. What we are looking for0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, datacenter operations, or a related hands-on technical role. jobs.desc: Gestionnaire de projet / Gestionnaire de programme sénior Description du posteNous recherchons un gestionnaire de projet expérimenté(e) qui jouera un rôle clé dans la concrétisation des engagements pris envers nos clients. À titre de responsable de la livraison, vous veillerez à transformer les objectifs définis lors de la vente en résultats tangibles, en assurant une exécution rigoureuse et une expérience client exemplaire.Dans ce rôle stratégique à forte visibilité, vous dirigerez des projets de déploiement de bout en bout, incluant l'installation à grande échelle d'infrastructures GPU, de calcul et de réseautique au sein des centres de données de nos clients. Vous serez responsable de la livraison des solutions dans le respect des échéanciers, des budgets et des engagements contractuels.À l'intersection de l'exécution opérationnelle et du conseil stratégique, vous mettrez à profit votre expertise en gestion des risques, votre capacité d'anticipation et votre intérêt pour les technologies émergentes afin de maximiser la valeur générée pour nos clients.Ce que vous réaliserezAu-delà des responsabilités traditionnelles de gestion de projet, vous agirez comme un partenaire stratégique de confiance pour nos clients. Votre contribution ne se limitera pas au suivi des échéanciers ou des jalons du projet; vous contribuerez activement à renforcer la confiance des parties prenantes, à anticiper et atténuer les risques avant qu'ils n'affectent la livraison et à identifier des occasions de création de valeur tout au long du cycle de vie de l'engagement.De la planification des activités quotidiennes à la coordination des équipes sur le terrain, en passant par la résolution d'enjeux opérationnels en temps réel, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant pour assurer la réussite des déploiements et faire en sorte que les résultats obtenus répondent pleinement aux attentes du client.Votre leadership contribuera directement à renforcer la réputation de Dell Technologies comme partenaire de confiance reconnu pour sa capacité à livrer des résultats concrets.ResponsabilitésVous devrez :• Effectuer des déplacements réguliers dans les centres de données des clients afin de diriger les activités de déploiement, notamment l'installation à grande échelle de racks GPU, de solutions de calcul et d'infrastructures réseau, tout en assurant la coordination des différentes parties prenantes et le suivi étroit des activités sur le terrain.• Agir comme principal point de contact auprès du client pour toutes les questions liées à l'avancement du projet, à la gestion des risques, aux escalades et à la résolution des enjeux associés à la logistique, aux installations et à la préparation des sites.• Veiller à ce que les engagements contractuels se traduisent par des résultats concrets et mesurables pour le client.• Identifier de façon proactive les risques susceptibles d'affecter le projet, notamment les retards d'échéancier, les contraintes de ressources, les dépendances fournisseurs ou les enjeux liés à l'état de préparation des sites, puis coordonner les actions nécessaires pour en limiter l'impact.• Adopter une approche-conseil auprès du client afin de maximiser la valeur générée par les solutions mises en œuvre et de repérer les occasions permettant de soutenir ses objectifs d'affaires à long terme.• Produire des rapports clairs, précis et réguliers à l'intention de la direction du programme et des principales parties prenantes.• Favoriser l'adoption de nouvelles approches, technologies et solutions propulsées par l'intelligence artificielle afin d'améliorer continuellement l'efficacité des processus de livraison, la qualité de l'information et la collaboration entre les équipes impliquées dans des déploiements complexes.Qualifications requises• De 10 à 12 années d'expérience en gestion de projets ou de programmes dans le domaine des technologies, du déploiement d'infrastructures informatiques ou des opérations de centres de données, incluant la réalisation de projets complexes destinés à une clientèle d'entreprise.• Excellentes compétences en communication, en coordination et en gestion des parties prenantes, avec la capacité d'exercer un leadership crédible auprès des équipes techniques, des fournisseurs, des entrepreneurs, des clients et de la direction.• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion simultanée de plusieurs volets de déploiement, tout en maintenant l'équilibre entre la portée, les échéanciers, les coûts et la qualité.• Disponibilité pour voyager fréquemment à travers le Canada (environ 50 % du temps) et travailler sur les sites clients pendant des périodes prolongées lorsque les projets l'exigent.• Solide capacité à résoudre des problèmes complexes et à gérer efficacement les incidents et les situations d'escalade dans des environnements à haut niveau d'exigence opérationnelle.Atouts recherchés• Maîtrise de Microsoft Project ainsi que des outils de planification et de gestion de projet connexes.• Intérêt marqué pour l'intelligence artificielle, l'automatisation et les technologies émergentes, particulièrement les environnements de centres de données optimisés pour l'IA ainsi que les technologies telles qu'InfiniBand, NVIDIA NVLink et Ethernet 400G/800G.• Solide compréhension des environnements techniques permettant d'interagir efficacement avec les architectes, les ingénieurs, les fournisseurs et les équipes de déploiement. Sans être responsable de la conception ou de l'implantation technique, vous devez être en mesure de comprendre les enjeux, de remettre en question certaines hypothèses et de faciliter la prise de décisions éclairées.• Capacité à lire et interpréter avec précision les plans et documents de construction.• Connaissance des normes OSHA ou volonté d'obtenir la certification OSHA 30. Renseignements complémentaires Ce rôle exige une grande capacité d'adaptation afin de répondre aux exigences des différentes phases de déploiement et aux horaires variables qui y sont associés. Les personnes candidates doivent être à l'aise dans des environnements complexes et à rythme soutenu, où la prise de décision sur le terrain joue un rôle déterminant dans la réussite des projets.Senior Project / Program ManagerJob DescriptionWe are seeking an experienced Project Manager, where you will serve as the critical bridge between what was sold and what is realized for our customers. You will operate at the intersection of hands-on delivery excellence and strategic advisory, leveraging predictive risk insights and an AI-forward mindset to drive measurable customer value. From managing daily workflows and shift-level task sequencing to resolving real-time onsite challenges, your work will directly ensure that the promise made during the sale becomes the reality experienced by the customer, reinforcing Dell Technologies' reputation as an outcomes-driven partner. You will:Travel regularly to customer data center sites to lead deployment activities - including GPU, network, and large-scale compute rack installations - coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and maintaining hands-on visibility into daily workflows, shift activities, and site readiness.Serve as the customer's trusted advisor and value orchestrator, translating contracted scope into realized outcomes while acting as the primary onsite point of contact for deployment status, risk escalation, and issue resolution across logistics, installation, and construction readiness.Deploy predictive risk insights to identify early warning signals - such as schedule slippage, resource gaps, vendor delays, or site-readiness blockers - and intervene proactively to protect delivery timelines and customer confidence.Drive lifecycle value and expansion opportunities by maintaining a consultative lens throughout the engagement, providing clear daily and shift-level reporting to program leadership, and surfacing areas where additional Dell Technologies solutions can accelerate the customer's business objectives.Embrace change, emerging technologies, and AI-driven tools to continuously improve delivery methodologies, reporting accuracy, and stakeholder coordination across complex, multi-workstream data center deployments.Essential Requirements:10-12 years of experience in project or program management within technology services, IT infrastructure deployment, or data center operations, with a proven track record of delivering complex, customer-facing deployment projects.Exceptional communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate as a credible onsite lead and advisor to technical teams, vendors, contractors, customer executives, and internal leadership simultaneously.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent deployment workstreams, balancing scope, schedule, cost, and quality - including daily task tracking, issue troubleshooting, and transparent reporting to program leadership.Willingness and ability to travel frequently (~50%) to customer data center sites across the Canada, including extended onsite rotational periods as project demands require.Demonstrated ability to apply formal problem-solving and issue-resolution methodologies to maintain project momentum, particularly during the real-time troubleshooting and escalation scenarios common in large-scale deployments.Desirable Requirements:Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project and related scheduling platforms. These roles will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and adjusting complex, multi-workstream deployment plans throughout the project lifecycle.A genuine enthusiasm for AI, automation, and emerging technologies - particularly experience with AI data center networking technologies and high-performance fabrics such as InfiniBand, NVIDIA NVLink, and 400G/800G Ethernet. While detailed design and implementation expertise is not required, an understanding of these technologies supports more effective installation sequencing, cross-functional coordination, risk identification, and escalation management.Strong technical acumen that enables effective engagement with architects, engineers, vendors, and deployment teams. While these roles are not expected to perform technical design or implementation work, technical fluency helps build credibility, facilitates informed decision making, and allows the PM to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and drive discussions toward resolution rather than simply serving as an intermediary.Ability to accurately read and understand construction documents/plans.Familiarity with OSHA standards, or a willingness to obtain OSHA 30 certification. Experience operation in multi-employer, multi-vendor construction or data center environments where safety responsibilities are shared across multiple parties.Additional NotesThis role requires flexibility to support varying schedules and deployment phases. Reporting to the Team Lead, IT Infrastructure & Operations, this position is responsible for developing and maintaining Microsoft Windows Server and SQL database environments and managing network infrastructure across two data centres.

The successful candidate will support software developers in delivering applications that meet business needs in a timely and effective manner. This role will also work closely with the Senior System Administrator in implementing a technology infrastructure roadmap that maximizes the organization's investments in hardware and software technologies.

What You’ll Do
• Design, develop, implement, and maintain server, database, and network infrastructure solutions.
• Monitor and tune corporate database and infrastructure environments for optimum performance.
• Research, evaluate, and recommend software products and tools related to database and infrastructure management.
• Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation and network infrastructure diagrams.
• Collaborate with project teams in the design, development, and review of technology solutions.
• Manage infrastructure-related projects according to established budgets and schedules.
• Perform backup duties on Microsoft SQL Server and Windows Server environments.
• Monitor critical IT infrastructure and respond to automated alerts to ensure systems remain operational

What You’ll Bring

Work Experience
• 3 - 5 years of Windows Server and Azure administration experience.
• 2 - 3 years of network infrastructure administration experience.
• 2 - 3 years of experience in managing and administering Exchange Online environments, including mailbox management, email flow configuration, and troubleshooting.
• Knowledge of the investment fund industry systems, operations, technical and business processes (an asset, but not required).

Education
• University Degree or College Diploma in Computer Science (or equivalent experience in the field).
• Preference will be given to applicants with relevant certificates and training in Information Technology.
• Preference will be given to applicants with current training and skill-sets.

Technical
• 3 - 5 years of hands-on experience in a Microsoft Server and Azure environment.
• 2 - 3 years of hands-on experience in Cisco switch and firewall environments.
• 2 - 3 years of Microsoft SQL Server administration, configuration, installation, and maintenance.
• Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate desired, but not required in lieu of experience configuring Azure services and resources.
• Cisco CCNA desired, but not required in lieu of experience configuring Cisco devices.
• Proficiency in writing and executing PowerShell scripts to automate administrative tasks, manage system configurations, and streamline workflows.
• Experience in performance monitoring of servers and networks.
• Experience in managing enterprise-level anti-virus and anti-malware hosted solutions.
• Familiarity with Hyper-V virtual environments and knowledge of mass storage platforms.

Soft Skills
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Organizational skills to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Ability to work with minimal supervision to prioritize and manage work.
• Ability to work as an effective member of a team.
• Strong attention to detail.

Operational Requirements
• Able to lift, move, and deploy (rack mount) IT equipment weighing 40 lbs. or more, including servers, PCs, routers, and switches.
• Comfortable working in server rooms and data centres, including high-voltage and noisy environments
• Able to deploy PCs and network equipment, including crawling under desks and accessing workstations where required.
• Able to work independently during early mornings, evenings, and weekends with minimal supervision.
• Capable of sitting or standing for extended periods while working at a computer.
• Able to provide after-hours support and respond to automated alerts affecting critical IT infrastructure

You Should Embody:
• Integrity: Demonstrates accountability, transparency, and sound judgment
• Leadership: Takes initiative and ownership of responsibilities
• Focus: Effectively manages time and delivers high-quality work under deadlines
• Passion: Shows commitment to continuous learning and process improvement
• Teamwork: Collaborates effectively with colleagues and stakeholders

What We Offer
• This position offers a salary range of $75,000-$85,000, with a discretionary bonus.
• An award-winning open-door culture with a collaborative & inclusive team
• Committed to flexible work arrangements, with heavily weighted remote work
• Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage + Lifestyle and/or Health Spending Accounts
• RRSP Matching that increases with tenure
• Parental Leave top up program
• Team connection through quarterly team lunches, bi-annual companywide events, sport and charity initiatives
• Support for professional learning and development
• Milestone recognition program

Application Information
• Number of positions: 1
• This is a new headcount, and we are actively recruiting for it.
• We use AI-enabled tools to sort applications based on job-related criteria. A human decides who moves forward. Some AI proctored tests may also be scored with AI; Trained staff review the scores before any decision is made.

IDEA & Accommodations (AODA)
SGGG-FSI supports a workplace that respects inclusion, diversity, equity and accessibility (IDEA). We appreciate the unique perspectives and experiences each of our employees bring to the job, and our success is underpinned by their contributions to our culture and our values.

SGGG-FSI welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Recruitment Process

• Online Assessment: Shortlisted candidates may need to complete a role based assessment.
• HR Screening: Virtual screening interview with our HR team.
• Manager Interview: Role specific interview held either virtually or in person.
• Decision: Decision communicated and updates provided at each stage.

Comfortable working under pressure in fast‑paced project environments
