jobs.title: Security Guard - Data Centre Security
jobs.desc:
Securitas Canada Limited is one of Canada's largest providers of security services and a leader within our industry. Over 8,000 employees provide security services to thousands of public and private customers, large and small, across all sectors and verticals. Securitas AB is the second largest provider of security services globally. We have business operations in 45 markets and capabilities spanning from guarding to tech-enables security. We provide Integrated Guarding, Remote Guarding, Mobile Guarding, Onsite Guarding, Investigative Services and Technology Services.

Securitas Canada is looking for professional and reliable Security Guards to join our team across a variety of client sites throughout the Greater Toronto area.

This posting is for multiple vacancies across the Greater Toronto Area.

Our Security Guards can work in a range of environments, and we are now looking for Security Guards to work in High Profile Data Centres across the Greater Toronto Area. We are looking for individuals for permanent full-time nights, part-time nights on the weekend or casual employment.

What You Will Do:

Control access to the site and verify visitors, employees, contractors.
Wand search and metal detection
Control access to restricted areas within the facility.
Maintain accurate daily activity and incident reports
Respond to incidents and emergencies in accordance with site procedures
Enforce client and site-specific security policies
Provide professional customer service to employees, visitors, contractors.
Maintain a visible security presence
Perform other security-related duties as assigned

What We Need from You:

Valid Ontario Security Guard Licence and First Aid and CPR Certificate
Strong communication and customer service skills
3-4 years of security experience, preferably with high level security sites.
Professional appearance and positive attitude
Ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations
Strong observation and attention to detail
Ability to complete written reports accurately
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Ability to sit and stand in a quiet enviornment.
Be able to meet the reliability clearances for
Reliable attendance and punctuality
Previous security experience is an asset, but qualified candidates with a strong customer-service background are encouraged to apply for more experienced roles.
Priority will be given to candidates with OPEN availability for days, afternoons, nights and weekend shifts and their own vehicle with a G licence. Some sites are NOT accessible by transit.

Why us?

Competitive pay opportunities
Free uniforms
Multiple site environments and assignments
Opportunities for full-time, part-time, and casual employment
Training and development opportunities
Opportunities to grow within the security industry and the sites.
Work with a global leader in security services

If you're a licensed security professional looking for an opportunity that matches your skills and availability, apply today.

A member of our recruitment team will review your application and contact qualified candidates to discuss current opportunities.

Please note: Assignment availability, pay rate, hours, and site requirements vary by location, experience and client. Thank you to all that apply. Those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Securitas Canada celebrates diversity, and we welcome and encourage applications from the four designated groups: namely women, aboriginal people, visible minorities and persons with disabilities. Accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified people to apply.

Securitas Canada does not ask for money or bank account or other sensitive financial information upfront or within job ads, including public job boards during the application process.

Further information about the Company: www.securitas.ca

#AF-CanadaGTSO

Securitas Canada's Mission:
Securitas’ mission is to protect homes, workplaces, and communities by providing the security services they need to protect their assets, safeguard their people, and maintain their ability to generate profits.

Securitas Aviation's Mission:
Securitas Aviation ensures the safety of passengers all over the world providing thorough security checks at airports in Canada

Our Values:
Securitas’ core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are the foundation for our employees to build trust with customers, colleagues, and the surrounding community.

Integrity:
Securitas employees are honest and trusted by customers to safeguard their premises and valuables. We don’t compromise on integrity and create an open forum for our employees and customers to voice opinions, report improprieties, and share information.

Vigilance:
Seeing, hearing, and evaluating. A Securitas employee is always attentive and often notices things that others don’t. Their vigilance is necessary in order to be aware of potential risks or incidents that may take place on our customers’ premises.

Helpfulness:
As part of an on-going effort to ensure safety, Securitas employees are always ready to help if an incident occurs that requires intervention regardless of whether or not it is directly related to their job. Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are represented by the three red dots in the Securitas logo. If you live by these values, we’re looking for you to join the Securitas team.

Thinking about a change?

We recognize that the construction industry is changing at a rapid pace and we continually strive to be at the forefront. Our core values empower people to deliver great careers to one another and develop creative solutions for complex problems on some of the most exciting projects. It doesn’t matter what your expertise and craft is – there are no boundaries. We are a group of professionals with a variety of expertise within pre-construction, construction, and post-construction. To learn more, check out our Cradle to Grave services and hear from our team directly about what a career at EllisDon could look like for you. As you can see, we are a diverse bunch.

Above all, we are a group of individuals with unique experiences and at EllisDon, we choose to celebrate the strength in our differences, every day. jobs.title: IT Network Support Analyst
jobs.desc:
JOIN OUR TEAM

Metro Supply Chain is a strategic supply chain solutions partner to some of the world's fastest growing and most reputable organizations. For 50 years, it has excelled at tailoring integrated, data driven solutions, fueled by advanced systems and technology, that fulfill complex and challenging distribution needs. Managing 22.5 million square feet operating out of more than 190 sites across North America and Europe with a team of 9,000, it is one of Canada's largest privately owned supply chain solutions companies. Metro Supply Chain is a 2026 winner of the Canada's Best Managed Companies program, recognized for its strategic expertise, culture of innovation and commitment to its people and local communities.

SUMMARY

The Network Support Analyst is responsible for supporting, maintaining, securing, and improving the organization’s network infrastructure across corporate offices, warehouses, data Centres, and remote sites. This role requires strong hands-on experience with enterprise networking technologies, including Fortinet firewalls, Cisco networking, and Aruba wired and wireless solutions. The individual will provide operational support, troubleshoot complex network issues, maintain accurate documentation, and coordinate network-related projects with vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and internal stakeholders.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Monitor, maintain, support, and optimize enterprise network infrastructure across corporate offices, distribution centers, warehouses, and remote locations.
• Administer and support Fortinet firewalls, SD-WAN, VPN connectivity, security policies, NAT, routing, and related network security services.
• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco and Aruba switching, routing, wireless infrastructure, VLANs, network segmentation, and Layer 2/Layer 3 services.
• Diagnose and resolve network incidents, performance issues, connectivity problems, and outages in accordance with service level objectives.
• Participate in the planning, implementation, testing, and support of network upgrades, site deployments, infrastructure refreshes, and technology initiatives.
• Monitor network availability, capacity, and performance using network management and monitoring tools; proactively identify and remediate potential issues.
• Collaborate with IT teams, business stakeholders, vendors, telecommunications providers, and managed service providers to ensure stable and secure network operations.
• Support WAN, Internet, MPLS, DIA, LTE/5G, and cloud connectivity services across multiple locations.
• Assist with network security initiatives, including firewall rule reviews, segmentation, access control, compliance requirements, and vulnerability remediation.
• Maintain accurate network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, standards, inventories, procedures, and operational runbooks.
• Support wireless infrastructure by performing troubleshooting, coverage validation, and optimization activities for warehouse and office environments.
• Participate in on-call support and incident response activities, including after-hours maintenance windows when required.
• Assist with the evaluation, testing, and implementation of new networking technologies and solutions to improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
• Follow established change management, incident management, and IT service management processes.
• Provide technical guidance and knowledge transfer to Service Desk staff and other IT team members.
• Ensure network infrastructure adheres to company security standards, best practices, and business continuity requirements.
• Support cloud networking initiatives, including connectivity to Azure, AWS, SaaS applications, and hybrid infrastructure environments where applicable.

EXPERIENCE

• Minimum 5 years of progressive hands-on experience in network administration, network support, or infrastructure operations within a multi-site enterprise environment.
• Strong experience supporting Fortinet firewalls, including firewall policy management, site-to-site VPN, remote access VPN, routing, troubleshooting, and security monitoring.
• Hands-on experience with Cisco and Aruba switching, routing, wireless networking, VLANs, trunks, spanning tree, routing protocols, and network segmentation.
• Experience working with vendors, telecom carriers, managed service providers, and third-party support teams to deliver network projects and resolve escalated incidents.
• Experience supporting network services in warehouse, distribution, office, and/or data centre environments is considered an asset.
• Demonstrated ability to document technical standards, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

EDUCATION

• Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, or a related field; equivalent hands-on experience may be considered.

PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

• Fortinet NSE, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Aruba Certified Switching/Wireless, or equivalent networking certifications are preferred.
• Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPN, wireless design, network security, and troubleshooting methodologies.
• Excellent communication, vendor coordination, documentation, analytical, and customer service skills.

Why Join Us

• Work in an environment where safety is our first priority
• The opportunity to build a career with a growing company
• Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family
• Life and disability insurance
• Wellness programs to support your family’s well-being
• A Retirement Savings Program with a company match
• Company team wear allowance
• Employee Appreciation Day
• Company sponsored social events
• Community volunteering

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building and fostering a diverse workplace where people feel included and valued. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals. Should you require accommodation for a special ability or need during the recruitment process, please reach out to a member of our Human Resources Team.

jobs.title: IT Network Technician
jobs.desc:
ThinkOn is expanding its Infrastructure Planning & Implementation team!

This is an entry-level role for someone starting their career in network operations. As an IT Network Technician at ThinkOn, you'll be the first set of eyes on our network — watching monitoring alerts, working the ticket queue, and making sure our network devices across multiple data centres stay healthy. You'll coordinate directly with carriers, data centre providers, and remote hands technicians to get circuits restored, hardware replaced under RMA, and physical work completed. You'll work alongside senior network engineers who will support your growth, and over time you'll take on more complex troubleshooting and configuration work.

We're looking for someone with solid networking fundamentals (CompTIA Network+ or equivalent knowledge), good follow-through, and the persistence to chase a ticket until it's resolved. Formal work experience is not required — we'll teach you the rest.

ThinkOn is a remote-first organization. At this time, we are welcoming candidates from Toronto, Ontario, Canada for this position. This position will be remote with occasional travel to data centre sites depending on location and need.

You Will:

Alert Monitoring & Triage

Monitor network and hardware alerts from Zabbix, Grafana, and Opsgenie throughout the business day.
Perform first-level triage — confirm whether an alert is real, identify the affected device, site, or circuit, and determine impact.
Follow established run books to resolve known issues and escalate to network engineers when an issue is outside your scope.
Track recurring or flapping alerts and flag them so the team can address the underlying cause.
Help keep alerting accurate by reporting false positives and stale monitoring entries.

Ticket Queue Management

Work the network team ticket queue — pick up, categorize, and prioritize incoming requests and incidents.
Keep tickets updated with clear, timely notes so anyone picking one up knows exactly where it stands.
Meet response and resolution targets and escalate before an SLA is at risk rather than after.
Close the loop with internal requesters and confirm the issue is genuinely resolved before closing a ticket.

Carrier & Circuit Coordination

Open, manage, and follow up on trouble tickets with carriers and transit/peering providers.
Gather and provide the information carriers need — circuit IDs, light levels, interface errors, test results, timestamps.
Coordinate intrusive testing windows and keep internal stakeholders informed of progress and expected restoration times.
Track carrier maintenance notifications, assess potential impact, and make sure the right people know in advance.
Chase updates persistently — a carrier ticket sitting untouched is one of the things this role exists to prevent.

Data Centre & Remote Hands Coordination

Work with data centre providers and remote hands technicians to complete physical work: cable runs, cross-connects, optic swaps, device re-seats, power cycles.
Write clear, unambiguous remote hands instructions — rack and unit location, port numbers, cable labelling, expected outcome, and verification steps.
Schedule access, submit tickets to data centre providers, and verify work was completed correctly before closing out.
Monitor data centre facility notifications (power, cooling, maintenance) and escalate anything that could affect our equipment.

Hardware RMAs & Vendor Management

Identify failed or failing hardware — switches, routers, line cards, optics, power supplies, fans.
Open RMA cases with vendors, collect and upload the required diagnostics and logs, and track cases through to replacement.
Coordinate shipping, receiving, and installation of replacement hardware with data centre staff.
Maintain accurate records of serial numbers, warranty and support contract coverage, and RMA status.
Flag devices that fail repeatedly or are approaching end of support.

Documentation & Inventory

Keep network device inventory, IP address records, and site documentation current and accurate.
Document what you did and what you learned — new run books, corrections to existing ones, and notes on issues that took time to solve.
Maintain up-to-date carrier circuit records: circuit IDs, provider contacts, escalation paths, and contract details.

You Have:

College diploma, degree, or technical certificate in Networking, IT, Computer Systems, or a related field — or equivalent self-taught/practical experience.
Eligibility to obtain Secret Level Clearance as of your first day of employment. This requires 10+ consecutive years of residency in Canada, as well as a Canadian Citizen.
CompTIA Network+ or equivalent certification, or demonstrable equivalent knowledge.
Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching basics — at the level of CompTIA Network+ or equivalent study/coursework.
Comfort with the command line: you can SSH into a device, run show commands, and read the output without being intimidated by it.
Understanding of physical infrastructure: copper vs. fibre, transceiver types, patch panels, racks and rack units, redundant power.
Basic troubleshooting tools: ping, trace route, and interpreting interface statistics and error counters.
General computer literacy: comfortable working across multiple web portals, ticketing systems, and monitoring dashboards at once.
Follow-through. This role lives or dies on chasing open items until they are closed. Nothing should fall through the cracks on your watch.
Clear written communication. You'll write ticket updates, remote hands instructions, and carrier correspondence every day, and they need to be unambiguous.
Attention to detail. A wrong port number in a remote hands request can take down a customer.
Willingness to ask questions. You're expected not to know things yet. You're also expected to ask rather than guess when the stakes are high.
Composure under pressure. Outages happen. We need you methodical, not rattled.

OpenText is a global leader in secure information management for AI, helping organizations unlock the value of information by connecting data, people, and processes while embedding security, governance, and compliance throughout the information lifecycle.

YOUR IMPACT:
OpenText is seeking a transformational technology executive to serve as Vice President, Global Data Center Portfolio& Transformation.
This leader will be the single accountable executive for the strategy, optimization, and transformation of OpenText's global data center portfolio, leading a multi-year effort to significantly reduce the physical footprint while creating a modern infrastructure foundation for the future.
The mandate includes transforming the current portfolio of approximately 63 data center sites toward a future-state footprint of approximately 10 strategic locations, while determining the optimal placement of workloads across retained facilities, colocation environments, and hyperscale cloud platforms.
The transformation will balance two complementary strategies:

• Consolidate and modernize approximately 50% of workloads into a smaller, standardized physical estate.
• Migrate approximately 50% of workloads toward hyperscaler platforms, using rehosting, replatforming, containerization, modernization, or retirement based on workload complexity, criticality, economics, security, regulatory requirements, and change tolerance.

The VP will partner closely with Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Product Engineering, Security, Finance, Procurement, Corporate Development, Facilities, and other executive stakeholders.
WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS:

• Define and execute OpenText's global data center portfolio strategy, driving consolidation, modernization, site optimization, and cloud adoption across owned, leased, colocation, private cloud, and hyperscale environments.
• Lead a large-scale infrastructure transformation program, reducing complexity and creating a more standardized, automated, secure, resilient, and cost-effective operating model.
• Establish workload placement and migration strategies, determining the optimal path for workloads across on-premises, colocation, and cloud platforms through modernization, migration, or retirement.
• Partner with Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Product Engineering, and Cloud teams to accelerate hybrid cloud transformation and support OpenText's Cloud and AI strategy.
• Own global capacity planning and infrastructure investment decisions across facilities, compute, storage, network, power, and cooling while optimizing total cost of ownership.
• Develop business cases, financial models, and multi-year roadmaps that align infrastructure investments with growth, modernization, M activity, and technology lifecycle strategies.
• Collaborate with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure infrastructure decisions meet security, resilience, privacy, regulatory, and data sovereignty requirements.
• Support acquisition integrations and divestitures by establishing scalable and repeatable infrastructure integration and separation strategies.Influence executive stakeholders and drive governance, risk management, and performance reporting for one of OpenText's most strategic transformation initiatives.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience across global data center infrastructure, cloud transformation, technology operations, or related enterprise technology environments.
• Proven experience leading large-scale data center consolidation, modernization, migration, and site-exit programs.
• Experience managing complex environments spanning data centers, colocation, private cloud, and hyperscale cloud.
• Strong financial and commercial acumen, including ownership of significant capital and operating budgets.
• Experience developing and executing multi-year technology transformation strategies with measurable business outcomes.
• Deep expertise in data center portfolio strategy, hybrid cloud, workload migration, infrastructure architecture, capacity planning, automation, security, resilience, and technology lifecycle management.
• Experience supporting M infrastructure integration and separation is highly valued.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Data Center Critical Environment Technician Manager.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I CE Technician Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

People Management

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.
Model - Live our culture; Embody our values; Practice our leadership principles.
Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes; Enable success across boundaries; Help the team adapt and learn.
Care - Attract and retain great people; Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations; Invest in the growth of others.

Equipment and Systems Operations

Serve as an operations specialist one or more major area of operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators, and work on advanced tasks independently.
Oversee and coach team with the inspection of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions to develop and analyze trends.
Monitor performance of maintenance and operations utilizing telemetry, control systems, and other platforms and is able to identify all alarms.
Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work and generate reporting to identify outstanding and ongoing work orders.
Safely and quickly respond to and lead an onsite incident response team for all abnormal conditions that impact operations and coordinate with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs.
Enhances, develops new, or follows preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to incidents.
Gathers necessary information and creates incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition.

Equipment and Systems Maintenance

Guide, oversee, and perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for one or more disciplines and one or more types of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems) and escalate when appropriate.

Advises colleagues on inspection and supervision issues.
Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems

Critical Environment Culture

Understands, follows, ensures, and coaches team on safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance with applicable federal, state, local, and Microsoft requirements.
Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.
Maintain safe working conditions and escalate immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed.
Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EH&S) objectives.
Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs.

Other

Embody our culture and values

High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 3+ years mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)

Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

The Data Center Technician is responsible for safely operating and maintaining critical MEP infrastructure while supporting reliable, 24/7 data center operations. Responsibilities include monitoring power and environmental conditions, performing preventive and corrective maintenance, completing site rounds, responding to incidents, and following MOP, SOP, EOP, CMMS, and Change Control procedures. Ensure that all MEP plant and distribution infrastructure is operated and maintained in a safe manner, to best industry practice and within manufacturers recommendations.

Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.

Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.

About the job

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

It is a requirement of the position that you obtain or currently hold a valid Reliability Status screening from the Government of Canada. The level of security screening required may change during employment to meet Google’s current business needs. Failure to obtain or maintain the appropriate clearance and/or customer screening requirements will make you ineligible for the position, which may result in the frustration of your employment and action up to and including termination.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our software developers, developers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Infrastructure & Capital Projects –Senior Vice President - Data Centers, COM

You’ve Never Been Satisfied with “Good Enough.”

You want to make an impact, not just manage projects, but change how the world gets built. At Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects, you’ll do exactly that. You’ll help develop and deliver the factories, grids, transit systems, and public infrastructure that keep communities moving - and do it smarter, safer, and more sustainable than ever before.

You’ll work alongside people who think big and act bold - project managers, engineers, technologists, and strategists who blend real-world experience with digital innovation and AI. Together, we’re transforming how capital projects are planned, managed, and executed, creating a better way to build for the future.

Because “good enough” builds the past. You’re here to build what’s next, on a team that outperforms every norm.

Visit us here to learn more about Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects

THE WORK

As Senior Vice President – Data Centers:

You'll open doors from day one, bringing existing relationships with data centre owners, operators, developers and the partner ecosystem around them, and converting those relationships into a qualified pipeline across [region/market] within your first two quarters.
You'll originate and close work yourself, identifying where clients need help on their capital programmes, leading the pursuit end to end, and signing multi-year advisory and programme management engagements rather than waiting for opportunities to be passed to you.
You'll shape the solution and the commercial model, designing the approach, team structure and pricing that answers the client's problem and stands up commercially for both sides.
You'll build the team behind the win, attracting senior practitioners into the Canadian market and standing up the delivery capability, locally and with global support, that scales as the pipeline converts.
You'll own delivery of what you sell, staying personally accountable for client outcomes, quality and commercial performance until the market reaches the scale to sustain dedicated delivery leadership.
You'll grow a market, not just an account: within 12 months you'll have a named client portfolio, a repeatable proposition and a team in place, establishing Canada as a scaled part of our global data centre business.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Flexible: The work location for this role will include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office or center.
With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

Minimum 10 years of experience on large-scale capital projects in the data centre or mission-critical sector, across advisory, cost and commercial management, project or programme management.
Minimum 5 years of experience originating and selling professional services or consulting work, with a demonstrable record of personally won revenue.
Minimum 5 years of experience accountable for delivery of capital programme engagements, including client outcomes and commercial performance.
Minimum 5 years of experience working directly with data centre owners, operators or developers in the Canadian market.
Minimum 3 years of experience building and leading teams, including hiring senior practitioners.
Fluent in French and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders in both languages.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

Experience working with or inside one or more hyperscale, colocation or major developer organisations.
Professional accreditation such as RICS, PMP, AACE/CCP, or chartered engineer status.
Experience on both owner side and consultant or contractor side of capital programmes.
Experience selling and delivering across multiple countries
Experience in adjacent capital-intensive sectors such as semiconductor fabrication, power and grid, or advanced manufacturing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:

Work on the largest and best projects: We advise and deliver on our clients largest, most complex capital programs, enabling more efficient use of capital and higher ROI.
Work with purpose: Be part of creating positive change and making the world better for our people, our clients, and the communities where we live and work. Embrace sustainability with everything you do, from how we service our clients, partners and communities to how we operate as a responsible business.
Work with reach: When you join us, you’ll work with the top companies with leaders from every industry. Across 120 countries and 40 industries, we work as one team with a common goal—to create 360-degree value by embracing change. While our global reach is impressive, you'll find that our I&CP Americas team is highly accessible and collaborative.
Grow and Thrive Professionally: We invest in you. With a $1.1 billion commitment to our team's learning and development, your growth is prioritized. Whether through leadership training, creative problem-solving workshops, or technical upskilling you have the resources to excel. Our flexible, omni-connected work model also supports a healthy work-life balance, adapting to both professional needs and personal circumstances.
Bring your true-self to work: Our commitment to our 775,000 people from a variety of cultures, beliefs and backgrounds makes us more innovative, and lets you bring self to work. Be on the forefront of technology that's creating a better future for all. Learn more
Make a difference: Connect your passions and purpose with your profession with opportunities to participate in corporate citizenship, Employee Resource Groups, eco-actions and development-partnership projects.
Awards and Recognition: We are recognized as leaders within program management and capital project professional services, having been ranked as the 7th largest program management firm by ENR (Engineering News Record). Accenture is recognized among the World’s Best Workplaces™ - Ranked #10 on the World’s Best Workplaces™ by Great Place to Work® and Fortune.

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Software Engineer, you will design, develop, create, modify, and validate embedded and cloud edge software, applications, and/or specialized utility programs that launch cutting-edge, world class products that meet and exceed customer needs. Qualcomm Software Engineers collaborate with systems, hardware, architecture, test engineers, and other teams to design system-level software solutions and obtain information on performance requirements and interfaces. Replacement Position

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
OR
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

• 3+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc.

We’re building the world’s most advanced SerDes PHY for use in AI data centers and beyond. The Embedded Software / Firmware Team at Qualcomm develops critical embedded software that powers high-performance multi-standard Serializer/ Deserializer (SerDes) PHY IP used in next-generation data center, AI/ML, automotive, and compute applications. Our SerDes IPs support standards such as PCIe, Ethernet, CXL, and are integrated into SoCs , ASICs , and chiplets built by leading semiconductor companies around the world.

The firmware team owns the full embedded software stack that controls the SerDes hardware, including low-level embedded firmware, customer-facing C SDKs, demo & automation scripts, and interactive tools. As a key enabler of silicon bring-up, validation, and production deployment, we work closely with hardware, systems, DV, validation, and application teams across the product lifecycle—from early development to high-volume manufacturing.

We are looking for an experienced Firmware Engineer to lead firmware architecture, development, integration, and bring-up for our SerDes PHY portfolio. The ideal candidate has driven firmware definition, architecture, and development starting from the RTL/digital design phase with EDA tool/simulator integration, all the way through to the post-silicon phase with device-level bring-up and debug. This is a highly collaborative role: you will work with hardware, systems, and software teams to drive requirements and successful chip bring-up; with firmware and embedded software engineers to drive code re-use across the organization; and with program managers to identify and meet deadlines. This individual will be instrumental in building next-generation SERDES PHY IP and semiconductors that meet Qualcomm’s high performance and quality standards.

What You Can Expect

Core responsibilities for the firmware team include:

Embedded firmware running on RISC-V-based controllers that manage Qualcomm’s advanced SerDes datapaths

Python and C SDKs provided to internal SoC teams and external customers for SerDes bring-up, calibration, tuning, and diagnostics

Python-based lab tools and GUIs for interactive debug, register access, and validation

Build, regression, and CI infrastructure to ensure code quality and full coverage.

Y ou’ll play a key leadership role in delivering robust, production-quality firmware for SerDes PHY IP. You’ll help define architecture, drive features end-to-end, coordinate across cross-functional teams, and directly influence the design and usability of Qualcomm’s designs .

In this position, you will be:

Technical or project lead for SerDes firmware on a major IP program, working with a team (2–8 engineers) through planning, development, validation, and customer delivery

Owning the entire firmware lifecycle for SerDes PHY, from pre-silicon design through post-silicon validation and optimization

Gathering requirements, studying high-level designs, developing device interface functions, and turning small building blocks into higher-level firmware system design

Architecting and implementing embedded C/C++ firmware for hardware calibration, training algorithms, DSP adaptations, and link state management

Working with multi-functional teams — ASIC/digital design, digital verification, software, and systems engineering — to define detailed bring-up and validation requirements and meet performance goals

Communicating requirements and coordinating execution across multiple teams and sites

Translating bring-up and validation requirements into efficient C/C++ firmware code and well-structured software organization

Translating protocol specifications (e.g. PCIe, Ethernet, CXL, UCIe) or custom system-level requirements into internal firmware architecture and documentation

Developing test and debug capabilities that help guide hardware design decisions for future product iterations

Debugging complex lab and field issues in conjunction with hardware, applications, and validation teams, and driving low-level SW, silicon, and HW issues to root cause and closure

Driving multi-functional teams and partners to address integration and bring-up challenges, ensuring chips are seamlessly brought up, validated, tested, and meet product and business requirements

Planning and developing test cases that improve reliability and release quality for internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring they run continuously in regression

Working with external vendors and customers to ensure requirements are met and releases are of high quality

Driving and collaborating across functions to define FW milestones, plan sprints, close tickets, and deliver reliable, high-quality features

Implementing industry best practices and documenting firmware and hardware design specifications and decisions

Mentoring junior engineers, promoting team building, and driving continuous improvement in processes and techniques

Demonstrating full ownership of assigned systems/components, managing timelines and resolving project challenges to meet program timing

Staying current with advancements in the semiconductor industry and incorporating relevant innovations into our processes

Supporting development and silicon bring-up across Qualcomm teams and other sites

Example Problems You’ll Solve

Mentoring a junior engineer through a hard-to-reproduce PHY calibration bug seen in customer silicon

Developing architecture and state machines to handle multi-lane synchronization or adaptive equalization across dynamic conditions

Porting a high-level MATLAB or Python SerDes calibration algorithm to optimized fixed-point firmware

Creating a SerDes diagnostics framework accessible via both SDK and GUI

Using simulation environments, EDA tool integration, and FPGA emulation to validate FW behavior before tapeout

Building error monitoring and board/interface configuration APIs that make link health observable to SoC software teams

Standing up a regression suite that catches link-training regressions before a customer release ships

Working with IP hardware architects to influence future revisions based on field debug learnings

What We’re Looking For

BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field

7+ years of experience in embedded C/C++ firmware development for hardware IP or SoCs, with strong proficiency in C/C++ and Python

Hands-on experience with embedded architectures such as ARM, RISC-V, or MIPS, and with low-level programming on bare metal, RTOS, BIOS/UEFI firmware, Linux kernel, or device drivers

Technical or team leadership experience in embedded software projects from spec to production

Deep understanding of microcontroller architecture (RISC-V a plus), memory-mapped registers, ISRs, and boot flows

Systems mindset and experience developing SW/FW to control analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuits

Experience with SerDes, Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, or D2D/UCIe/chiplet products and communication systems

Strong lab debug skills, working directly on silicon with scopes, JTAG debuggers, I2C/SPI tools, analyzers, and custom tooling, including bring-up and diagnostics of high-speed signals

Familiarity with industry-standard EDA tools and methodologies used for digital verification, and with HDLs such as Verilog and SystemVerilog

Familiarity with git and modern software development methodologies

Excellent organizational and communication skills, a willingness to learn, and the ability to collaborate across functions and geographies

Preferred Experience:

Knowledge of SerDes and high-speed IO standards (PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, CXL, etc.)

Experience with calibration algorithms, signal conditioning, and adaptive feedback control in hardware

Experience in silicon bring-up and post-silicon debug

Experience developing drivers for multiple devices at the PCB level to interact with whole systems

Experience working with FPGAs such as Xilinx, Zed, and MicroZed

Hardware hands-on and debugging experience, such as power, SI, and EMC validation and tuning

Scripting in Python, Bash, etc. for lab automation and testing

Familiarity with digital design concepts (Verilog/ SystemVerilog ), simulation, and DV flows

Exposure to the OSI model, especially the physical and data link layers

Understanding of signal processing concepts such as eye diagrams, jitter, BER, SNR, and CTLE/DFE/FFE

Experience with Jira, Agile/Scrum, and Confluence

jobs.desc:
Location
Toronto, Ontario, Canada
Capabilities
Digital and Data
Office Setup

Industry
Advanced Manufacturing

At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.

Your impact

We are seeking an experienced electrical engineer with deep expertise in power systems modeling, rotating machinery, and electrical controls to join our digital twin and pre-commissioning simulation practice. This mid-level role targets a professional with 5–10 years of experience who brings rigorous electrical engineering fundamentals and the applied interest to translate that knowledge into high-fidelity simulation models that de-risk commissioning and validate design decisions before field equipment is energized.

You will be a core technical contributor across a portfolio of digital twin and pre-commissioning simulation engagements spanning data centers, distributed energy, advanced manufacturing, and other power-intensive critical infrastructure. Working within a multidisciplinary simulation team, you will develop and validate dynamic electrical models within physics-based simulation platforms; design and execute scenarios covering contingency analysis, transfer and ride-through validation, generation control logic, fault simulation, black-start sequencing, and capacity analysis; and deliver technically rigorous outputs that translate simulation findings into actionable commissioning guidance.

Responsibilities

Electrical Power Systems Modeling

Dynamic Model Development – Build physics-based dynamic models spanning the full power path—from utility supply or on-site generation through switchgear and distribution to load endpoints. Represent key equipment characteristics including rotational inertia, governor type and response, droop control, alternator winding parameters, ATS transfer timing, UPS topology and bypass logic, and branch circuit coordination.
Rotating Machinery & Generation – Develop models of reciprocating engine-generators, combustion turbines, and hybrid generation configurations. Accurately represent governor and AVR behavior, paralleling switchgear synchronization, load-sharing characteristics, and generation source interactions during paralleling, load transfer, and unit trip events. Model BESS grid-forming and frequency/voltage response behavior where applicable.
Transient, Harmonic & Protection Analysis – Model transients and power quality phenomena including voltage and frequency deviation during transfer events, RoCoF under generation loss, THD under non-linear loading, and UPS waveform degradation during fault events. Model protection relay coordination, overcurrent device selectivity, and breaker trip/reclose logic. Evaluate outputs against applicable standards including ITIC/CBEMA and IEEE 519.

Use Case Development & Simulation Execution

Contingency & Fault Simulation – Develop and execute N-1/N-2 contingency scenarios, ATS open- and closed-transition transfer scenarios, and UPS power path fault scenarios. Assess power margin, overload duration, waveform quality, ride-through behavior, and load transfer success against defined acceptance criteria. Design cascading multi-system fault scenarios to evaluate failure behavior, alarm escalation logic, and load shedding sequences.
Black-Start Sequencing – Model and execute complete startup from de-energized conditions, sequencing generation ignition, governor stabilization, switchgear closure with synchronization verification, UPS initialization, and load energization. Identify automation gaps, validate interlock release logic, and document the full sequence timeline from de-energized conditions to stable generation and load acceptance.
Capacity & Expansion Envelope Analysis – Model phased expansion scenarios to evaluate whether planned electrical infrastructure can support incremental load additions with acceptable redundancy margins. Produce headroom analyses, uptime projections, and fuel-limited runtime assessments to support go/no-go decisions at each expansion milestone.

Control Logic Validation & Commissioning Support

Sequence of Operations Validation – Simulate and validate programmed electrical control sequences—ATS transfer logic, generator paralleling and synchronization, and UPS redundancy and bypass sequences—against project control narratives and design intent. Document pass/fail results against a defined test matrix.
Control System Testing – Support integration of PLC logic into the simulation environment and execute control system factory acceptance testing against live or emulated controllers. Identify control logic deficiencies, coordinate corrective actions, and retest updated logic prior to field deployment.
Interlock & Protection Validation – Validate interlock release conditions, protection relay logic, alarm propagation, and emergency shutdown sequences. Confirm that safety-critical automation functions correctly without manual intervention under simulated fault and contingency conditions.

Architecture Assessment, Reporting & Practice Development

Architecture Review & Gap Analysis – Review project electrical documentation—one-line diagrams, protection coordination studies, I/O lists, control narratives, and EPMS configurations—to assess instrumentation coverage and data availability. Identify metering and instrumentation gaps and recommend remediation strategies.
Technical Reporting – Develop simulation reports documenting use case findings, failure scenario results, SOO validation outcomes, and performance compliance analyses. Produce quantitative outputs—power efficiency predictions, capacity margins, fuel runtime assessments, and protection coordination evaluations—with stated confidence intervals and documented assumptions. Contribute to operator training materials and model handover documentation.
Practice Contribution – Contribute to reusable model libraries, simulation methodologies, and standardized testing frameworks. Support technical scoping and proposal development for new simulation opportunities. Collaborate with mechanical, I&C, and other simulation engineers to ensure correct multi-domain model integration.

Here's what you'll need
5–10 years of electrical engineering experience with at least 3 years in power systems design, analysis, protection engineering, or simulation for data centers, industrial facilities, power generation, or critical infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience developing or contributing to dynamic electrical models for simulation or digital twin applications, covering equipment such as generators, combustion turbines, UPS systems, ATS, switchgear, paralleling gear, and power distribution infrastructure.
Working knowledge of rotating machinery characteristics relevant to simulation: governor and AVR behavior, paralleling and synchronization logic, droop control, rotational inertia, and generator fault response.
Familiarity with electrical transient and power quality phenomena including ATS transfer excursions, RoCoF under generation loss, THD under non-linear loading, and UPS waveform behavior during fault events; ability to evaluate outputs against ITIC/CBEMA and IEEE 519.
Working knowledge of PLC-based electrical control logic and ability to read control narratives, protection coordination studies, I/O lists, and one-line diagrams to develop and validate simulation models.
Familiarity with SCADA and EPMS platforms and integration of electrical monitoring data into engineering workflows (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, or equivalent).
Strong technical documentation skills; able to produce simulation reports, deficiency logs, and performance analyses with confidence intervals and documented assumptions.
Effective cross-functional collaborator; able to coordinate with controls integrators, OEM representatives, commissioning managers, and project engineering teams. Willing to travel up to 25% of time.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with physics-based or dynamic simulation platforms for electrical or power systems modeling (e.g., ETAP, PSCAD, SKM Power Tools, EMTP, Modelica-based tools, or comparable); familiarity with proprietary pre-commissioning simulation environments is a plus.
Background in mission-critical or distributed generation infrastructure, including paralleling switchgear, emergency and standby power system design, large UPS architectures, or hyperscale data center power distribution.
Experience with control system FAT or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing for electrical or power systems in industrial or mission-critical commissioning environments; familiarity with PLC emulation platforms is a plus.
Experience with protection coordination analysis and relay logic validation in simulated or physical test environments.
Knowledge of power performance metrics for mission-critical facilities (PUE, generation efficiency, fuel consumption) and performance threshold frameworks.
Exposure to BESS modeling including grid-forming inverter behavior, frequency and voltage response, and hybrid generation plant integration.
Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (BACnet, Modbus, DNP3) in power monitoring and EPMS applications.
Professional Engineer (PE) license in Electrical Engineering, or active pursuit, is a plus.

Minimum Education & Preferred Focus Areas

Bachelor’s degree required in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology from an ABET-accredited program.
Master’s degree preferred in Electrical Engineering with focus on power systems, energy systems, or controls engineering.

Overview:

AWS CLOUD ARCHITECT

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Architect to lead the design and execution of cloud migration initiatives for critical banking systems and infrastructure. The role will focus on architecting secure, resilient, scalable, and audit-ready AWS environments while managing the unique technical, security, and regulatory considerations associated with migrating financial systems from legacy on-premises data centers. The successful candidate will work closely with Risk, Compliance, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, and application teams to ensure cloud solutions meet regulatory and institutional standards while enabling business continuity and modernization

Primary Location:

Toronto, ON

Work Model:

Hybrid 3-Days Onsite

Employment Type:

Contract

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design end-to-end AWS architectures for migrating on-premises banking applications, core systems, and data to AWS with minimal disruption to critical financial services
Lead discovery and dependency mapping of legacy environments including mainframes, core banking platforms, databases, and middleware to determine appropriate migration strategies
Define and execute migration approaches including rehost, replatform, refactor, and retire
Develop detailed migration plans and runbooks aligned with regulatory change-control, business continuity, and disaster recovery requirements
Architect AWS landing zones, VPCs, network segmentation, and security controls aligned with banking security and data residency requirements
Design and support hybrid connectivity solutions using AWS Direct Connect, VPN, and Storage Gateway
Partner with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and internal control requirements
Define encryption, key management, identity and access management, privileged access, and other security controls appropriate for financial data
Develop infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation to enable consistent, auditable, and repeatable deployments
Produce architecture documentation, control evidence, risk assessments, and other materials required for audits and regulatory examinations
Collaborate with application owners and engineering teams on cloud-native modernization and refactoring of core banking, payment, and customer-facing systems
Establish cloud cost governance and optimization practices including tagging, chargeback, Reserved Instances, and Savings Plans
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering and infrastructure teams on secure AWS architecture patterns
Serve as a technical liaison during regulatory examinations, third-party risk assessments, and internal audits related to cloud infrastructure

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Senior-level experience as a Cloud Architect, AWS Cloud Architect, Solutions Architect, or similar role
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing enterprise AWS cloud architectures
Proven experience leading large-scale migration of on-premises infrastructure and applications to AWS
Strong understanding of AWS services including VPC, IAM, KMS, CloudHSM, Direct Connect, VPN, Storage Gateway, and related networking and security services
Experience designing AWS landing zones, network segmentation, secure connectivity, and multi-account cloud environments
Strong understanding of hybrid cloud architectures and on-premises to AWS migration strategies
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation
Experience with cloud security, encryption, identity and access management, privileged access, and data protection
Experience working with enterprise risk, compliance, information security, and architecture teams
Strong understanding of business continuity, disaster recovery, change management, and operational resilience
Experience creating architecture documentation, migration runbooks, risk assessments, and audit/control evidence
Strong understanding of enterprise networking, databases, middleware, and legacy infrastructure
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams
Experience working in regulated environments, preferably financial services or banking

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with banking, financial services, or other highly regulated environments
Knowledge of financial industry regulatory frameworks such as FFIEC, GLBA, PCI-DSS, SOX, and OCC guidance
Experience migrating core banking platforms, payment systems, transaction processing platforms, or customer data environments
AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Security – Specialty
Experience with AWS Control Tower and enterprise cloud governance
Experience with cloud cost management and FinOps practices
Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, or third-party risk assessments
Experience mentoring cloud engineering and infrastructure teams
Experience with cloud-native modernization and application refactoring

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.desc:
ThinkOn is seeking a skilled and motivated Cloud Platform Engineer to support the deployment, management, and ongoing operations of secure, multi-tenant VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) 9.x environments with GPU integration and edge deployments. This platform supports government workloads at the Protected B classification level and includes platform services such as Database as a Service (DBaaS), secrets management, centralized logging, and monitoring.

As a key member of the Secure Cloud Platforms team, you will be responsible for the lifecycle management of infrastructure and platform components across core and edge data centre sites, ensuring high availability, security, compliance, and operational excellence. This role requires a strong technical foundation in VMware technologies, Zero Trust principles, and infrastructure-as-code best practices.

ThinkOn is a remote-first organization. At this time, we are welcoming candidates from Canada for this position. Please note that this listing is for a current vacancy at ThinkOn. We are looking for qualified candidates who are eager to contribute and grow with us. If you're interested in this opportunity, we encourage you to apply soon, as we are reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

It is a mandatory requirement for the position that the candidate must be eligible to obtain Canadian Secret Clearance. To meet this eligibility, the candidate must be a Canadian citizen or permanent resident for at least 10 consecutive years and must have at least 10 years of verifiable background information. This is essential to ensure compliance with federal security standards and to support the sensitive nature of the projects involved. Candidates who do not meet this criteria will not be considered for the role.

You Will:

Deploy, configure, and maintain VMware VCF 9.x environments including vSphere, vSAN, NSX-T, SDDC Manager, and GPU-enabled clusters.
Operate and manage platform-level services such as centralized logging (Splunk), monitoring (Zabbix), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), and DBaaS.
Ensure secure operation of the environment in accordance with Zero Trust principles and Protected B requirements.
Manage network segmentation and enforce multi-tenant isolation across service delivery and platform layers.
Monitor infrastructure health, performance, and availability across core and edge sites.
Perform patch management, software upgrades, and infrastructure maintenance with minimal disruption.
Support integration of subscriber identity management systems (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID) for federated access.
Work collaboratively with security, compliance, and network teams to ensure alignment with organizational standards and regulatory obligations.
Create and maintain documentation, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
Participate in incident response and root cause analysis for platform-level issues.

You Have:

5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, systems administration, or VMware-focused engineering roles.
Deep understanding of VMware VCF (vSphere, NSX-T,vSAN, SDDC Manager).
Experience with GPU compute environments (e.g., NVIDIA A100, L40) in virtualized infrastructure.
Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture and its implementation in multi-tenant environments.
Experience with infrastructure automation (Ansible,PowerCLI, Terraform).
Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, Bash).
Hands-on experience with platform observability (e.g., Splunk, Zabbix), secrets management (e.g.,HashiCorpVault), and SIEM/SOC workflows.
Strong knowledge of RBAC, federated identity systems (e.g., Entra ID/Azure AD), and secure access design.
Ability to manage complex systems across distributed environments (core + edge).
Canadian citizen or permanent resident eligible for federal clearance.

Nice to Have:

VMware certifications (VCAP, VCP-DCV, VCF Specialist).
Experience with infrastructure automation (Ansible, PowerCLI, Terraform).
Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, PBMM, or ITSG-33.
Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, Bash).
Previous experience supporting government or regulated environments

Benefits and Perks:

A remote-first culture
Competitive compensation package
Flexible time-off for vacation; 5 personal days/year
Comprehensive health and dental benefits
A $500* Wellness & Learning allowance
Eligible to join the ThinkOn Group Retirement Savings Plan
Referral Bonuses for successful hires

Founded in 2013, ThinkOn is a managed infrastructure services provider (MISP) with a global data center footprint, focused on empowering partners to do whatever they need to do with their data. ThinkOn’s team of data-obsessed experts protect clients’ data like it’s their own, making it more resilient, secure, actionable, and searchable. ThinkOn is Channel First and works with a global network of value-add resellers and managed service providers to provide creative, turnkey Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), Disaster Recovery-as-a-Service (DRaaS), and Backup-as-a-Service (BaaS) solutions and data management services that are fast, flexible, scalable, highly secure, and cost-effective with predictable pricing and no hidden fees. jobs.title: Hiring for Network Engineer - Toronto
jobs.desc:
*Job Summary*

We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled Network Engineer to join our team in Toronto! In this vital role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust network infrastructure to support our organization’s operations. Your expertise will ensure seamless connectivity, optimal network performance, and top-tier security across diverse environments including data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise networks. If you thrive in a fast-paced setting and are passionate about network architecture and security, this opportunity is perfect for you!

Top 3 Required Skills:
- DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) Engineering & Architecture – Expert-level experience with enterprise DDI platforms (Infoblox, BlueCat, Diamond IP), DNS/DHCP design, redundancy, failover, and large-scale operations.
- DNS/DHCP Administration & Troubleshooting – Deep understanding of DNS architecture, DNS security (DNSSEC, SPF, DMARC, DKIM), DHCP services, IPv4/IPv6 management, and advanced root cause analysis.
- Network Engineering & Automation – Strong experience with Python/Bash scripting, REST/SOAP APIs, Linux/Unix administration, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and network automation in enterprise environments.

Top 3 Preferred Skills:
- Cloud & Hybrid DNS Architecture – Experience designing and managing scalable DNS solutions across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments.
- Public DNS, CDN & Traffic Management – Experience with domain registrars, public DNS management, Akamai/Cloudflare CDNs, GTM/GSLB, SSL/TLS, and traffic steering.
- Banking/Financial Services & Compliance Experience – Exposure to regulated environments, audit/compliance requirements, SIEM tools (Splunk/ELK), and ITIL processes.

Education Requirements:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
- DDI Certifications (Infoblox/BlueCat) preferred.
- CCNA/CCNP certifications are considered a strong asset.

Key Qualifications Summary:
8+ years of Network Engineering experience, including 5+ years of hands-on DDI platform experience.
Expertise in enterprise DNS, DHCP, IPAM, IPv4/IPv6, and large-scale network services.
Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, and APIs.
Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to lead complex enterprise DDI initiatives, including cloud migrations, M&A integrations, and DNS security implementations

Pay: $50.00-$60.00 per hour



Experience:
* dns: 5 years (preferred)
* dhcp: 5 years (preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Toronto, ON

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager

What sets us apart is our relentless pursuit of innovation. We leverage the latest advancements in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and software-defined networking to provide our clients with a competitive edge in an increasingly interconnected world. Our solutions are designed to not only meet the current demands of the digital landscape but to also anticipate and adapt to future challenges.At Arista we value the diversity of thought and perspectives that each employee brings to the table. We believe that fostering an inclusive environment, where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome, is essential for driving creativity and innovation.Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as Best Engineering Team, Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest standards of quality and performance in everything we do.Job DescriptionQualified candidates must reside in and have sold complex networking solutions in the greater Toronto Area.Who You'll Work WithAs a team member of the Arista Sales team, you are the face of Arista to our customers; their internal champion for the problems they need to solve. As their champion you will align Arista’s technical resources to achieve your customer’s business outcome. You will partner with some of the most skilled Customer Engineers in the industry in addition to our Professional Services and Executive teams to help them understand how to execute on your customer’s behalf. Our sales teams have a culture of team success, where you’ll collaborate and be supported by like minded sales professionals. This role typically reports to a Regional Sales Manager or Area VP of Sales.What You'll DoWe are seeking a proven Territory Account Manager to join our growing Sales organization. As a Territory Account Manager will act as a trusted advisor and implement sales strategies to exceed sales targets within a targeted list of commercial accounts.Arista appeals to forward-thinking organizations that value quality and innovation. Consequently, technical acumen and a track record of selling data center solutions is highly desirable.Job ResponsibilitiesExceed measurable sales objectives and extend the Arista brand within a named list of 30-40 commercial accounts across Ontario.You will be responsible for utilizing a consultative selling approach with key client stakeholders to address the business needs of hybrid cloud computing and siloed legacy IT systems across the Arista product portfolio including, Software-Driven Open Networking switching platforms or high performance Data Centers and Campus networks including our Cognitive Campus WI-FI networking solution in addition to the DANZ Monitoring Fabric and Network Detection & Response (NDR) and End Point Security solutions.Meet with key influencers, decision-makers, and C-levels to present Arista’s value proposition.Work with Arista systems engineers to design and position compelling solutions that drive down the total cost of ownership.Collaborate with technology partners to identify prospects and demonstrate best-in-class solutionsEstablish and manage key channel relationships in your territory.Formulate strategic and tactical account plans based on periodic business reviews with your prospects and customers.Conduct demand generation activities such as happy hours, lunch-n-learns and technology forums.Collaborate with Arista peers on marketing plans and best practices.Keep up-to-date with technology partner solutions, competing solutions and competitor strategies.QualificationsYou possess a hunter mentality and have a proven track record of technology sales including cultivating relationships with existing customers in addition to penetrating new logo accounts. You are an influencer and possess the ability to act as a trusted advisor to deliver business value to both end users and key business stakeholders.Our team looks for individuals who embody our values of trust, compassion, collaboration, respectfulness, integrity, and good-natured fun.Minimum Job RequirementsBS/BA degree or equivalent in addition to 5+ years of technology sales experience.Proven track record of direct selling into target accounts within the assigned territory and exceeding sales targetsRelevant data center or networking (LAN/WAN, SDN) industry background from a technology partner, competitor, channel partner or end user is a a requirement. Strong rolodex and relationships within the territoryExcellent people skills and ability to build relationships at all levelsYou possess previous selling experience and technical acumen in one or more of the following areas; Networking, SDN, NFV, Switching, Network Automation, Routing, Data Center, Edge Computing, Network Virtualization, Hyper-converged infrastructure or Cloud computing.Additional InformationArista offers different pay ranges based on work location, so that we can offer consistent and competitive pay appropriate to the market. The actual base pay offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and work location.The pay range provided reflects base pay only and in addition certain roles may also be eligible for discretionary Arista bonuses and equity. Employees in Sales roles are eligible to participate in Arista’s Sales Incentive Plan, which pays commissions calculated as a percentage of eligible sales. Employees are also entitled to benefits including medical, dental, vision, wellbeing, income protection and a Group Retirement Savings Plan. This posting is for an existing, open position within our team. The recruiting team can share more details during the hiring process specific to the role and location.

You will work with customers to understand their technical and business requirements, qualify the opportunity, identify the right turnkey GPU infrastructure solution, and manage opportunities throughout the sales process.The successful candidate must be able to sell the full lifecycle of a GPU cluster solution at an executive-summary level and drill down into the components as needed — from planning and design through build, deployment, management, monitoring, operations, and monetization. For commission roles, the salary listed above represents BMO Financial Group’s expected target for the first year in this position.BMO Financial Group’s total compensation package will vary based on the pay type of the position and may include performance-based incentives, discretionary bonuses, as well as other perks and rewards.
