jobs.title: Data Center Field Services Technician
jobs.desc: About ELITSELITS Canada Inc. is Part of Accelerate, within the IVER Group in Sweden. IVER Group has approximately 1,300 employees and continues to grow. As Part of Accelerate, you will work at the forefront of technology on exciting digitization and transformation projects with market‑leading customers. We are passionate about realizing digital opportunities in the cloud and, together with our customers, closing the gap between aspiration and successful implementation. Communication is an essential part of the work since we collaborate closely with our customers. As an employee at ELITS, you will become part of a great team that responds with humility and takes pride in what we deliver.About This OpportunityELITS is looking for a highly motivated and skilled Data Center Field Services Technician to lead work in customer data centers and co‑location facilities around Mississauga. You will be the technical interface between customers and third-party providers, ensuring smooth execution of fiber and transport work and removing obstacles so work stays on track. This role includes travel to other locations of up to approximately 25% of the time.Key Responsibilities Lead and audit fiber and transport activities in customer data centers and co-locations. Install, decommission, remediate, and perform break/fix on connectorized fiber cabling and related hardware in large data center environments. Conduct optical testing and troubleshooting using power meters, light sources, OTDRs, visual fault locators, and transport test sets. Interpret methods of procedure, cut sheets, network diagrams, and vendor documentation to execute changes safely and accurately. Configure patch panels, implement loopbacks and test jumpers on the front of panels without disturbing rear terminations, and maintain clean, labeled cable management. Apply proper fiber handling and cleaning practices using approved tools and methods. Communicate clearly with customer and third-party teams through ticketing tools and face-to-face updates, and document all work in customer systems.Required Skills And Experience Minimum 2.5 years of hands-on fiber installation experience, including at least 1.5 years in large data center or similar mission-critical environments. Proven team lead experience with face-to-face customer interaction, acting as the operational bridge between customer stakeholders and third-party providers. Strong experience with single-mode and multimode fiber, LC connectors, fan-outs, and structured cabling. Ability to interpret optical power measurements and make sound troubleshooting decisions based on dBm readings and loss results. Proficiency with proper fiber cleaning methods and use of approved fiber cleaning tools and materials. Ability to configure and verify front-of-panel loopbacks and test jumpers without disrupting rear fiber terminations. Clear understanding of correct fiber type selection, including use of single-mode fiber for appropriate device-to-device links. Strong English communication skills and proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office applications for documentation and reporting. High integrity, self-motivation, and attention to detail. Ability to multitask and stay composed in fast-paced, high-availability environments. Commitment to safety standards, quality requirements, and operational best practices.Other Requirements Ability to lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs. Comfortable working at heights and in varied environmental conditions. Comfortable using a smartphone and laptop for communication, ticketing, and documentation. Willingness to travel as needed for customer and project requirements.QualitiesAt ELITS Canada, great people create great impact. Success in this role comes from curiosity, ownership and a passion for building practical, scalable solutions. You are someone who: Thrives in a collaborative, cross‑functional team and communicates with clarity and confidence. Balances strong technical depth with pragmatic, solution‑oriented decision making. Takes initiative, works independently and is comfortable owning technical outcomes. Brings structure and discipline to documentation, standards and operational excellence. Contributes to a culture of trust, learning and continuous improvement.Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada (Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or valid work permit holder).ELITS – Part of Accelerate – IVER GroupGrow together with passionate people. Do you value a corporate culture that’s built on transparency, honesty and trust?Do you want to give yourself the best conditions for succeeding?Do you want to work with people who inspire you and share their skills and competence? Do you want to feel part of something positive? And do you want to grow and develop with the best IT specialists in the business?Then welcome to ELITS - Accelerate at IVER

jobs.title: VP, Data Center Portfolio & Transformation
jobs.desc: Opentext - The Information CompanyOpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.OpenText is a global leader in secure information management for AI, helping organizations unlock the value of information by connecting data, people, and processes while embedding security, governance, and compliance throughout the information lifecycle.As OpenText advances its Cloud and AI strategy, its infrastructure must evolve to support a more agile, secure, resilient, automated, and economically optimized operating model.Your ImpactOpenText is seeking a transformational technology executive to serve as Vice President, Global Data Center Portfolio & Transformation.This leader will be the single accountable executive for the strategy, optimization, and transformation of OpenText's global data center portfolio, leading a multi-year effort to significantly reduce the physical footprint while creating a modern infrastructure foundation for the future.The mandate includes transforming the current portfolio of approximately 63 data center sites toward a future-state footprint of approximately 10 strategic locations, while determining the optimal placement of workloads across retained facilities, colocation environments, and hyperscale cloud platforms.The Transformation Will Balance Two Complementary StrategiesConsolidate and modernize approximately 50% of workloads into a smaller, standardized physical estate.Migrate approximately 50% of workloads toward hyperscaler platforms, using rehosting, replatforming, containerization, modernization, or retirement based on workload complexity, criticality, economics, security, regulatory requirements, and change tolerance.The VP will partner closely with Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Product Engineering, Security, Finance, Procurement, Corporate Development, Facilities, and other executive stakeholders.What The Role OffersDefine and execute OpenText's global data center portfolio strategy, driving consolidation, modernization, site optimization, and cloud adoption across owned, leased, colocation, private cloud, and hyperscale environments.Lead a large-scale infrastructure transformation program, reducing complexity and creating a more standardized, automated, secure, resilient, and cost-effective operating model.Establish workload placement and migration strategies, determining the optimal path for workloads across on-premises, colocation, and cloud platforms through modernization, migration, or retirement.Partner with Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, Product Engineering, and Cloud teams to accelerate hybrid cloud transformation and support OpenText's Cloud and AI strategy.Own global capacity planning and infrastructure investment decisions across facilities, compute, storage, network, power, and cooling while optimizing total cost of ownership.Develop business cases, financial models, and multi-year roadmaps that align infrastructure investments with growth, modernization, M&A activity, and technology lifecycle strategies.Collaborate with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure infrastructure decisions meet security, resilience, privacy, regulatory, and data sovereignty requirements.Support acquisition integrations and divestitures by establishing scalable and repeatable infrastructure integration and separation strategies.Influence executive stakeholders and drive governance, risk management, and performance reporting for one of OpenText's most strategic transformation initiatives.What You Need To Succeed15+ years of progressive leadership experience across global data center infrastructure, cloud transformation, technology operations, or related enterprise technology environments.Proven experience leading large-scale data center consolidation, modernization, migration, and site-exit programs.Experience managing complex environments spanning data centers, colocation, private cloud, and hyperscale cloud.Strong financial and commercial acumen, including ownership of significant capital and operating budgets.Experience developing and executing multi-year technology transformation strategies with measurable business outcomes.Deep expertise in data center portfolio strategy, hybrid cloud, workload migration, infrastructure architecture, capacity planning, automation, security, resilience, and technology lifecycle management.Experience supporting M&A infrastructure integration and separation is highly valued.OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.Compensation: At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.Salary Range: Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.AI Usage Disclosure: As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Centre Operations and Development
jobs.desc: Role Overview:Qu Data Centres is a rapidly growing, private-equity-backed digital infrastructure platform operating data centres across Canada. The Vice President, Data Centre Operations and Development will lead national portfolio performance, reliability, customer experience, expansion readiness, capital deployment, and operational excellence as Qu scales colocation, connectivity, AI, and high-density compute capacity.This is a unique opportunity to join a company at a transformative stage of growth and play a key leadership role in scaling one of Canada's leading digital infrastructure platforms. The successful candidate will bring an ownership mindset, balancing operational performance, customer commitments, profitability, capital efficiency, and long-term growth objectives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.Key Responsibilities:Strategic Leadership Define and execute the operational vision for Qu’s data centre portfolio, including high-density (HD) and low-density (LD) colocation environments. Lead initiatives to modernize and scale products and sites, including partnering with engineering and design teams to maximize available sellable capacity and translate priorities into a practical multi-site CAPEX deployment plan.Develop and implement a 100-day tactical plan focused on operational readiness, customer experience, strategic expansion, operational controls, and near-term CAPEX execution priorities.Build and operate against a robust set of KPIs and metrics.Have a deep understanding of overall and site-level economics including costs, profitability, capital deployment, and alignment to business cases and return objectives.Develop and execute on a customer physical move plan as required to create more sellable contiguous colocation capacity.Ability to build consensus and alignment through clear communications, collaboration, and terminology.Design and ConstructionLead design and construction readiness for data centre expansion and retrofit initiatives, including utility power capacity, electrical, mechanical, and architectural design inputs, professional partner engagement, equipment selection and procurement, schedules, budgets, permitting, and independent commissioning.Operational Excellence Oversee facility operations, including uptime, SLAs, capacity utilization, change management, provisioning, maintenance governance, commissioning readiness, operational turnover, vendor management, and critical infrastructure resilience.Optimize space, power, and cooling inventory to balance customer commitments, site economics, and future growth capacity. Ensure compliance with health and safety, security, and regulatory standards across all sites.Maintain accurate documentation, operating data, and single-source-of-truth reporting for stakeholders, including as-builts, SLDs, occupancy, reserved capacity, consumption, BMS, EPMS, DCIM, maintenance records, and sellable-capacity trends.Maintain standardized security, compliance, and site-control practices, including access control, visitor and contractor procedures, escorts, shipping and receiving, surveillance, zoning, monitoring, audit readiness, and evidence management.Develop, maintain, and test emergency, incident response, and business continuity procedures, including escalation protocols, root cause reviews, and corrective action tracking.Lead and measure energy-efficiency initiatives, including power and energy consumption review, mechanical efficiency programs, free cooling, containment, and other PUE-reducing measures.Provide operational oversight for telecom infrastructure services, including Meet-Me Rooms, cross-connects, points of entry, and conduit management.Customer Experience & Commercial Enablement Have a deep understanding of customer contracts, obligations, and service commitments, and ensure these remain aligned with site capabilities, operating standards, and delivery feasibility.Oversee customer installation, service-change, and de-provisioning processes to ensure reliable, SLA-aligned execution.Support larger bids, designs, and proposals by translating space, power, cooling, network, and CAPEX deployment constraints into clear guidance on deliverability, capex, and customer commitment timing.Team & Organizational DevelopmentBuild and lead a jobs.title: Data Center Critical Environment Technician Manager - Evening shift
jobs.desc: OverviewNote: This position is for the evening shift. Additionally, due to the nature of this role, the employee will be required to be available on-call as needed, including weekends, and holidays, to support operational needs. The employee may be expected to respond within a reasonable timeframe when contacted and may be required to provide support either remotely or on-site. These expectations will be applied in a manner consistent with applicable employment standards legislation.In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Data Center Critical Environment Technician Manager.Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I CE Technician Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.ResponsibilitiesPeople Management Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.Model - Live our culture; Embody our values; Practice our leadership principles.Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes; Enable success across boundaries; Help the team adapt and learn.Care - Attract and retain great people; Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations; Invest in the growth of others.Equipment and Systems OperationsServe as an operations specialist one or more major area of operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators, and work on advanced tasks jobs.title: Facilities Operator
jobs.desc: About BeanfieldWe don’t just build networks, we build communities. From our roots in Liberty Village to our growing footprint across Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver, Beanfield has spent 35+ years connecting people through a robust, independently owned fibre-optic network.With 500+ employees and an entrepreneurial mindset, we move fast, think creatively, and stay connected to the people who make Beanfield what it is. If you thrive in a collaborative, high-impact environment where your work matters, you will feel right at home.Our headquarters is located in Toronto’s super-hip Liberty Village, surrounded by great coffee, food, energy, and creativity—making it a great place to collaborate in person.Our ValuesWe Are Challengers  We lead the way. We disrupt the industry by thinking differently, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We operate with a startup mentality and believe in building and investing in our own infrastructure, and our people.We Are United  We operate as one team. Collaboration is core to how we work, and every idea matters. We believe strong partnerships and shared ownership lead to better outcomes.We Care  We care deeply about our employees, partners, customers, and communities. We build trust through open communication, thoughtful decisions, and a relentless focus on our brand and customer experience.The RoleThe Telecommunications - Equipment Installer (Facilities Operator) is responsible for the installation and maintenance of telecommunication equipment at a variety of Beanfield equipment locations. This includes fibre, transport equipment and all critical infrastructures within these equipment offices. This role will provide high-quality service in these technical spaces including data centres, telephone switch centres, central office wire centres, and designated enterprise spaces. What You’ll DoEquipment Installation & Infrastructure:     ·   Hardware Operations: Install, modify, and decommission telecom facility equipment, including cable trays, telco racks, cabinets, servers, switches, routers, fuse panels, and telco-grade battery systems. ·   Cabling & Power: Measure, route, terminate, and label AC/DC power cables, fibre optic cables, and wires across facility infrastructure spaces. ·   System Turn-Up: Execute test-and-turn-up procedures and integrate new network hardware into live production environments.      Technical Quality & Troubleshooting     ·   Technical Compliance: Read and interpret complex engineering blueprints, schematics, system specifications, and Methods of Procedure (MOPs). ·   Testing & Validation: Conduct system performance testing for hardware and software to evaluate efficiency, reliability, and integration compatibility. ·   Critical Power & Backup Systems: Maintain and test -48V DC power plants, rectifier systems, battery banks, UPS units, and emergency standby generators. Perform routine load testing and fuel management. ·   Environmental & Facility Controls: Monitor HVAC, CRAC units, and temperature/humidity control systems within active switching and server rooms. Conduct routine inspections of fire suppression systems and physical facility integrity. ·   Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware, power, and connectivity issues as they arise. ·   Quality Assurance: Perform in-process and post-installation quality validation audits to ensure strict adherence to industry standards. Operations:·   Maintain complete operational documentation, including daily status reports, project logs, and administrative records. ·   Perform other facility operations duties as required. What You Bring   High school diploma or equivalent required, technical or college degree preferred.    Minimum of three years of central office equipment installation experience    Clear understanding of telecommunication and data centre Quality Standards    Background in fiber optic cable and AC/DC power installation and testing practices    Proficient use of Microsoft programs, IOS and/or Android applications.    Demonstrated problem-solving skills, ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.    Ability to read and understand technical drawings and documentation such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.    Strong mechanical aptitude including usage of basic power tools.    Strong organizational skills.    Excellent verbal and written communication skills    Ability to write routine reports and documentation.    Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record and proof of insurance    Must be able to regularly lift up to 50 lbs., and occasionally lift over 50 lbs.    Physical demands of the job: must be able to: sit, stand, stoop, crouch, climb throughout the shift.    Overtime and Weekend work may be required based on business need.  Must love dogs. Yes, you read that right, we have our very own office dog! What’s in it for you   A united, values-driven culture that genuinely cares about people, collaboration, and community.    A comprehensive total rewards package, including Traditional Spending Account (TSA) and Health Care Spending Account (HCSA) coverage to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.    An additional five (5) personal care days, giving you extra flexibility to recharge, reset, or take care of what matters most.   At Beanfield, we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.We believe that diverse teams make stronger teams. No matter your background, experience, or life story, if you meet the requirements for this role, we want to hear from you. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment, without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or any other protected status.Beanfield provides reasonable accommodations at all stages of the recruitment and selection process. If you need support during your application or interview, please reach out to us at recruitment@beanfield.com, we are happy to help.Please note: Actual total compensation will be determined based on factors such as knowledge, skills, performance and experience. The salary range indicated includes a Short Term Incentive Plan (“STIP”) which represents a percentage of your Base Salary based on the achievement of individual and corporate objectives; The STIP payment is calculated based on a formula that takes into account several factors, including, without limitation, corporate and individual performance measures. The STIP payment is conditional upon meeting all of the STIP’s eligibility requirements. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada, as we are unable to sponsor employment visas. Also, all official communication regarding recruitment and hiring at Beanfield will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @beanfield.com. We urge candidates to be cautious of any unsolicited messages or offers and to remain vigilant against phishing attempts.

jobs.title: Data Center Technician
jobs.desc: This posting is for an existing vacancy.Google utilizes AI tools to assist in assessing candidates in our hiring processes.Minimum qualifications:Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware. Experience with networking protocols.  Experience with Linux system administration.Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting. Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.Preferred qualifications:Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems. Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.).Experience working within a data center or network operation center environment. Experience in project management and leadership, and collaborating and partnering with teams.About The JobGoogle isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.It is a requirement of the position that you obtain or currently hold a valid Reliability Status screening from the Government of Canada. Please note that information provided to the Canadian Government in connection with the screening is not affiliated/shared with Google. Evidence of the completed screening will be required to be provided directly by you to Google upon the start of your employment, and will not otherwise be shared with Google by the Government of Canada. The level of security screening required may change during employment to meet Google’s current business needs. Failure to obtain or maintain the appropriate clearance and/or customer screening requirements will make you ineligible for the position, which may result in the frustration of your employment and action up to and including termination.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. jobs.title: MSP Network Technician
jobs.desc:
*About XBASE*

XBASE has managed IT infrastructure for Canadian organizations since 1988. We run three geographically dispersed Tier 3 data centres, and a 24/7/365 live answered support desk.

We are 100% Canadian and 100% in house. No offshoring, no subcontracting. Every ticket, every project and every escalation is handled by someone on our Toronto team. That model only works if the people we hire are strong, so we hire carefully and we keep people for a long time. Several of our client relationships run past 30 years, and so do several of our staff.

*The role*

You will build, configure and support the networks that our clients run their businesses on. This is hands on work: switches, firewalls, routing, wireless, VPN, structured cabling coordination, and the Linux systems that sit behind them. Some days you are in the office working tickets and change requests. Some days you are at a client site or in one of our data centres racking and cabling gear.

We are looking for someone who fixes the cause rather than the symptom. If a client calls us three times about the same problem, we treat that as our failure, not theirs. The technicians who do well here are the ones who dig until they understand what actually happened, then close the gap so it does not happen again.

You will report to the Director of Network Operations.

What you will do

* Configure, deploy and support Cisco and Fortinet networks: switching, routing, FortiGate firewall policy, SD-WAN, IPsec VPN, ZTNA
* Deploy and support wireless infrastructure, including site surveys, AP placement and RF troubleshooting
* Build and maintain Linux servers and appliances (Ubuntu) used for monitoring, automation and infrastructure services
* Write and maintain Ansible playbooks and roles that push configuration to network devices and Linux hosts, so that builds are repeatable rather than hand crafted
* Take escalations from the service desk, diagnose to root cause and document the fix
* Execute network changes during scheduled after hours windows, with rollback plans written before the window opens
* Rack, cable, label and document equipment in client sites and in XBASE data centres
* Keep network documentation, diagrams and IP address management current
* Contribute to project work: office moves, firewall replacements, circuit cutovers, ISP and carrier coordination
* Work within our SOC 2 Type II controls, including change management and evidence capture

*What you need*

* Solid hands on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise networks in production, not just in a lab
* Working knowledge of Cisco switching and routing: VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, static and dynamic routing, port security
* Working knowledge of Fortinet: FortiGate policy and NAT, VPN configuration, FortiSwitch and FortiAP where present
* Comfort on the Linux command line: package management, systemd, networking stack, SSH key management, log analysis
* Practical Ansible experience, or strong scripting experience plus a clear willingness to move to Ansible quickly
* The ability to read a packet capture and reason about what the network is actually doing
* Clear written English. Documentation and ticket notes are part of the job, not an afterthought
* Legal eligibility to work in Canada
* A valid Ontario driver's licence and access to a vehicle, for client site and data centre visits
* Willingness to complete a criminal record check, credit check and consent to client mandated background screening, as required by our SOC 2 Type II controls and several client contracts

*What helps*

* Certifications: CCNA or CCNP, NSE 4 or higher, RHCSA, Network+
* Experience in an MSP or other multi client environment
* Experience with Ruckus wireless, Ubiquiti
* Familiarity with virtualization (VMware, Proxmox, Hyper-V) and storage concepts
* Exposure to Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Intune in a hybrid environment
* Git, CI pipelines, or any experience treating infrastructure as code

What we offer

* $45,000 to $52,000 per year, reviewed annually
* [Health, dental and vision benefits]
* [Paid vacation and personal days]
* [Paid certification and exam costs]
* Real equipment, real budgets and a lab where you are expected to break things before clients see them
* A team that has been doing this since 1988 and has no interest in growing by cutting corners

Pay: $45,000.00-$52,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Casual dress
* Company events
* Dental care
* Disability insurance
* Discounted or free food
* Life insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* On-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Network Designer & Implementer
jobs.desc:
Location: can be located anywhere in Canada within proximity to a CGI location to support a hybrid work environment.

Anticipated start date: Mid December

Accelerate infrastructure delivery through automation by designing, developing, and implementing innovative solutions that improve operational efficiency, enhance service quality, and reduce manual effort. Partner with engineering, operations, and client teams to build scalable, secure, and reliable automation capabilities that enable faster service delivery, continuous improvement, and exceptional client outcomes.

CGI is seeking an experienced Senior Network Designer & Implementer to design, engineer, implement, and evolve enterprise network infrastructure for a major financial services client. This is a senior hands on role requiring deep expertise across Cisco networking, F5 application delivery/load balancing, Palo Alto Networks security, and Network Automation / Infrastructure as Code (IaC). The role owns the lifecycle from requirements and HLD/LLD through implementation, testing, validation, documentation, operational handover, and production support. The environment is highly available, security sensitive, and regulated, with strong expectations for resiliency, security, scalability, automation, operational stability, auditability, and disciplined change governance.

The ideal candidate is a senior Network Designer/Engineer who combines enterprise networking depth with modern automation capabilities. This is not a purely architectural role: the individual must be equally comfortable with solution design, hands on configuration, troubleshooting, production changes, validation, and technical leadership. Core platform strengths are Cisco (enterprise/data centre), F5 (application delivery/load balancing), and Palo Alto (network security/firewalls), supported by an automation first mindset using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, Git, and IaC.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

. Lead secure, scalable, resilient, highly available network solution design; translate business, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, and operational requirements into HLDs/LLDs covering topology, routing, connectivity, security, load balancing, resiliency, performance, and operations.
. Develop implementation, migration, validation, and rollback strategies; assess existing infrastructure and recommend modernization/optimization; document design decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, trade offs; participate in design/architecture reviews.
. Lead hands on implementation across development, test, staging, DR, and production; configure, deploy, upgrade, validate, and troubleshoot network/security infrastructure; prepare MOPs and implementation plans; support after hours/weekend production windows when required.
. Coordinate end to end implementation with Network, Security, Application, Server, Cloud, Storage, DNS, Operations, and vendor teams; ensure solutions conform to approved designs and standards and transition completed solutions into operations/support.
. Provide senior technical leadership, mentoring, design/troubleshooting facilitation, vendor coordination, POC/product evaluation support, and continuous improvement across network engineering, automation, documentation, and standards.

Core Technology Expertise
Cisco Networking

. Design/implement Layer 2/3 networks; advanced routing/switching and troubleshooting; BGP, OSPF and EIGRP where applicable; VLANs, trunking, STP, link aggregation, segmentation, routing domains, QoS, high availability, redundancy, and inter data centre connectivity.
. Hands on experience with Cisco Nexus, enterprise switching and routing platforms; Cisco ACI strongly preferred; understanding of SDN/controller based networking; capacity/performance engineering, lifecycle upgrades, and troubleshooting of latency, packet loss, asymmetric routing, and connectivity issues.
. Perform configuration/design reviews, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions.

F5 Application Delivery & Load Balancing

. Design, implement, troubleshoot, upgrade, and migrate enterprise F5 BIG IP/LTM solutions, including Virtual Servers, Pools/Pool Members, Health Monitors, Profiles, SSL/TLS profiles, SNAT, Persistence, and Traffic Policies; design highly available architectures.
. Understand HTTP/HTTPS, TCP, TLS, DNS, application traffic flows, SSL termination/offload, and certificate management considerations; F5 DNS/GTM and iRules are highly desirable; F5 APIs/automation strongly preferred.
. Partner with application teams to translate availability and traffic management requirements into F5 configurations.

Palo Alto Networks Security

. Design and implement secure Palo Alto NGFW architectures, including security rules/policies, NAT, zones/interfaces, routing integration, application/service policies, segmentation, HA, and centralized management with Panorama.
. Use App ID/User ID where applicable; understand threat prevention/security profiles; perform troubleshooting, policy optimization/rule base hygiene, software upgrades, lifecycle activities, and integration with automated provisioning/configuration workflows.
. Work with Cybersecurity to meet security standards and controls; Prisma Access/cloud based Palo Alto capabilities are an asset.

Network Automation & Infrastructure as Code
Network Automation is a key requirement. Demonstrated ability to move network engineering from manual configuration to repeatable, version controlled workflows is expected.

. Develop automation for provisioning, configuration, validation, compliance, backups, drift detection, and pre/post change checks across Cisco, F5, and Palo Alto platforms where supported; use APIs for programmatic interaction.
. Build reusable scripts/modules/workflows; integrate automation with CI/CD; maintain code in source control; apply code review, testing, approval, and deployment controls; reduce manual effort, configuration errors, and implementation risk.
. Core tools: Python, Ansible/Ansible Automation Platform, REST APIs, JSON/YAML, Git, CI/CD, IaC. Beneficial: Terraform, NetBox, vendor APIs/SDKs, Jenkins/GitLab/GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps, network validation/testing frameworks, Netmiko/NAPALM/Paramiko or equivalents.
. Automation must be supportable, reusable, secure, controlled, and suitable for enterprise operations.

Security, Resiliency & Financial Services Controls

. Apply secure by design, least privilege, segmentation, defense in depth, controlled administrative access, privileged access, logging/monitoring, configuration traceability, and approved change management practices; coordinate with Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Architecture, and Audit.
. Complete required security assessments/approvals, maintain audit evidence, support vulnerability remediation and audit findings, and meet financial services technology/security requirements.
. Design for redundancy, fault tolerance, active/active or active/standby as appropriate; minimize single points of failure; validate failover/recovery; support DR planning/testing and resiliency exercises; align to application RTO/RPO where applicable and document service dependencies.

Troubleshooting, Change & Documentation

. Provide senior troubleshooting across routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and applications; analyze end to end traffic; troubleshoot routing, DNS, TCP, SSL/TLS, latency, packet loss, firewall, and load balancing issues; perform packet captures/traffic analysis; lead RCA and permanent corrective actions; use automation to prevent recurring issues.
. Prepare change records, implementation/validation/communication/rollback plans; participate in technical/CAB reviews; coordinate dependent teams; execute within approved windows; perform post change validation and recovery; maintain strong change hygiene.
. Maintain HLDs, LLDs, diagrams, traffic/security flows, implementation/migration plans, MOPs, test/validation and rollback plans, SOPs, configuration standards, automation runbooks, operational support documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.

Required qualifications to be successful in this role

Mandatory Qualifications & Experience

. 10+ years of enterprise network engineering experience with significant hands on design and implementation responsibility in large, complex environments.
. Strong hands on expertise with Cisco networking, F5 BIG IP/LTM, and Palo Alto Networks firewalls/Panorama; advanced TCP/IP, routing/switching, BGP/OSPF, and Layer 2/3 troubleshooting skills.
. Demonstrated experience with resilient/high availability architectures and business critical production environments.
. Demonstrated Network Automation experience using Python, Ansible, APIs and/or IaC, plus Git/source control.
. Experience producing HLDs/LLDs, implementation plans, network diagrams, production changes, and complex multi tier application connectivity troubleshooting.
. Strong network security/segmentation knowledge; strong written/verbal communication; able to work across infrastructure, security, application, cloud, operations, vendors, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

. Financial services experience (banking, payments, capital markets, insurance) and highly regulated/security sensitive environments; Cisco ACI; F5 DNS/GTM and iRules; Prisma Access; AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid/multi cloud networking; SDN; Terraform; network CI/CD; automated testing/validation; ServiceNow/ITSM integration; monitoring/observability/telemetry; DNS/DHCP/IPAM; data centre migration/network transformation; distributed teams/managed service providers.
. Certifications: CCNP Enterprise/Data Center, CCIE, F5 Certified Technology Specialist, Palo Alto PCNSE, AWS/Azure/GCP networking, Red Hat Ansible Automation, HashiCorp Terraform, and/or ITIL. Equivalent hands on experience accepted.

Working Conditions

. Location: Anywhere in Canada.
. Work model: Hybrid – minimum three days per week in office.
. Schedule: Standard eight hour workday; occasional after hours, evening, or weekend work may be required based on project or operational needs.
. Travel: No travel required.

Security & Compliance Requirements

. Must be eligible to obtain and maintain Government of Canada Protected B Security Clearance.
. Must adhere to all client security, operational and compliance policies.
MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

. 10+ years of enterprise network engineering experience with significant hands on design and implementation responsibility in large, complex environments.

. Strong hands on expertise with Cisco networking, F5 BIG IP/LTM, and Palo Alto Networks firewalls/Panorama; advanced TCP/IP, routing/switching, BGP/OSPF, and Layer 2/3 troubleshooting skills.

. Demonstrated experience with resilient/high availability architectures and business critical production environments.

. Demonstrated Network Automation experience using Python, Ansible, APIs and/or IaC, plus Git/source control.

. Experience producing HLDs/LLDs, implementation plans, network diagrams, production changes, and complex multi tier application connectivity troubleshooting.

. Strong network security/segmentation knowledge; strong written/verbal communication; able to work across infrastructure, security, application, cloud, operations, vendors, and business teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

. Financial services experience (banking, payments, capital markets, insurance) and highly regulated/security sensitive environments; Cisco ACI; F5 DNS/GTM and iRules; Prisma Access; AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid/multi cloud networking; SDN; Terraform; network CI/CD; automated testing/validation; ServiceNow/ITSM integration; monitoring/observability/telemetry; DNS/DHCP/IPAM; data centre migration/network transformation; distributed teams/managed service providers.

. Certifications: CCNP Enterprise/Data Center, CCIE, F5 Certified Technology Specialist, Palo Alto PCNSE, AWS/Azure/

At Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects, you’ll do exactly that. You’ll help develop and deliver the factories, grids, transit systems, and public infrastructure that keep communities moving - and do it smarter, safer, and more sustainably than ever before.You’ll work alongside people who think big and act bold - project managers, engineers, technologists, and strategists who blend real-world experience with digital innovation and AI. Together, we’re transforming how capital projects are planned, managed, and executed, creating a better way to build for the future.Because “good enough” builds the past. You’re here to build what’s next, on a team that outperforms every norm.Visit us here to learn more about Accenture Infrastructure & Capital Projects(Internal Title: Project Management II) THE WORK:Program & Project ManagementEnd-to-End Hyperscaler Program Delivery & Documentation: Lead end-to-end program and project management initiatives, including drafting comprehensive Program Charters, Program/Project Plans, schedules, change management processes to govern large scale deployment, Project Requirements Documentation (PRDs), actionable roadmaps, and official operational procedure documents.Sprint Planning & Execution: Formulate monthly sprint plans and develop robust implementation strategies to ensure deliverables are met on time and with exceptional quality.Risk & Schedule Management: Proactively review and analyze project schedules to identify, assess, and mitigate risks that may impact project delivery. Provide recommendations to management on process and policy improvements to reduce recurring delays and improve schedule performance for major capital equipment and projects exceeding $10 million.Cross-Functional Communication & Stakeholder ManagementTechnical-to-Operational Translation: Bridge the gap between highly technical engineering teams and operations teams by translating technical data on data center designs to identify delayed equipment and supply chain risks into clear, actionable steps.Global Strategic Liaison: Manage diverse client stakeholder groups and perform conflict resolutions. Seamlessly coordinate and drive alignment across cross-functional global teams, including onshore and offshore resources operating across highly diverse time zones and cultural environments.Advisory & Process Improvement: Analyze operational and platform data to advise senior leadership on managerial and procedural changes (such as risk and schedule management workflows); propose improvements to internal methods, workflows, and communications based on audit findings to improve the effectiveness of project management methods leading to the predictable and accelerated delivery of hyperscale data center construction projects globally.Data Center Supply Chain & Construction KnowledgeMulti-Vendor Orchestration: Manage alignment, coordinate resources, and track project progress within a highly complex environment consisting of 15 to 20+ specialized hardware and infrastructure vendors.Supply Chain Logistics: Track supply chain risks and monitor specialized data center infrastructure and equipment scheduling to ensure seamless site status updates.Data Center Infrastructure & Equipment Expertise: Apply deep operational knowledge of specialized data center equipment (including server racks, cooling infrastructure, and power units), their high-level uses, manufacturing processes, key global suppliers, and lead times. Leverage this technical domain knowledge to recommend transferring equipment, modifying existing hardware configurations, or fast-tracking production to resolve critical supply bottlenecks.Senior Leadership Alignment: Translate complex technical, logistical, and program data into high-level status updates and strategic recommendations for senior executive leadership.Testing, Workflow Optimization & Systems trainingPlatform & Dashboard Administration: Serve as the subject matter expert and primary administrator for proprietary client planning and governance platforms. Manage end-to-end data integrity and custom dashboard reporting across 200 to 300 active sites, tracking delays for multiple hundreds of individual equipment pieces simultaneously to prevent tracking inaccuraciesQuality Assurance (QA) & User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Design and execute QA processes and perform UAT on newly developed tools, supply chain tracking applications, and project management platforms.Quality & Compliance Auditing: Design and conduct quality audits on internal platform tools to ensure system reliability and feature accuracy. Perform compliance audits across 100+ client sites to verify timely and accurate vendor construction schedule submissions, escalating gaps and conflicts to leadership.Rapid Tool Adoption: Demonstrate the ability to learn new software applications quickly and rapidly produce clear process workflows for client use.Team Training & Enablement: Create training programs and lead the onboarding and ramping up of new technical team members to ensure rapid integration into active infrastructure programs.Client Advisory & Capital Project DeliveryClient Advisory: Provide advisory services to clients on capital project delivery, project management practices, and operational challenges by analyzing business requirements, evaluating risks, and recommending solutions to support project objectives.Business Process Improvement: Conduct analyses of client operations, project performance, and business processes to identify issues, assess alternatives, and recommend solutions that improve organizational effectiveness and support the successful delivery of capital projects.AI EnablementAI Workflow Automation: Deliver training programs using AI tools(such as Google Gems) to automate manual project management workflows.AI Skill Set: Have in-depth knowledge of using AI tools for process optimization and project management.Specialized Skills & ToolsProject Management Tools: Advanced proficiency with MS Project, Asana, and similar professional project management software. Ability to learn client specific project management tools.AI & Workflow Automation Certification: Completed formal certification or verified professional training in AI-enabled program management, demonstrating structured knowledge of using artificial intelligence to optimize project schedules, automate routine reporting, and build custom workflow agents.Domain Knowledge: Solid operational understanding of the data center industry, specialized hardware (e.g., server racks and infrastructure components), capital planning, and global multi-vendor (15–20+) supply chain logistics.Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to manage client relationships, handle stakeholder friction, and drive alignment across diverse business units.Adaptability: Proven ability to master new technology platforms quickly and map out clear operational workflows for client teams.Work LocationThis is a hybrid role requiring a combination of remote and onsite work. Regular weekly attendance is required at Accenture's offices located at 41 King Street West, Toronto, ON and 1595 16th Avenue, Richmond Hill, ON.Additional onsite attendance may be required based on business needs. Candidates must be able to travel to and work from both office locations as needed.WORKING CONDITIONS:Office-basedHERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:Minimum 2 years of experience in data center infrastructure, hyperscaler deployment, or mission-critical facilities, including data center construction, specialized hardware deployment, and multi-vendor supply chain coordination.Bachelors degree in education, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain Management, Project Management, Economics, or a related field. A postgraduate certificate in Business Management is considered an asset.Advanced proficiency with MS Project, Asana, and or similar professional project management software.Must have a recognized certification such as PMI Project Management, ReadyTM, Agile/Project Management certification and Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)Working Knowledge of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, and project governanceEnglish language proficiency is required to communicate effectively with management and other stakeholders, as well as to prepare and review documentation.BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:In-depth understanding of prevailing Project Management methodsCompetent in the application of tools and metrics needed to evaluate project performanceProficient in project management softwareAbility to arrange priorities and escalate competing risks to meet deadlinesKeen eye for detail and adept problem-solving abilitiesMust have demonstrated experience relaying and receiving information (written and verbal)Equipped to work independently and as part of a teamThe recruiting efforts for this position are intended to fill a brand-new position.The base pay range shown below is intended as a guideline to reflect the majority of offers for this role.Role Location Annual Salary RangeToronto & Richmond Hill, Ontario $95,000 to $103,000Benefits & Compensation: Vacation entitlement, 5 paid personal days, extended health care, vision and dental coverage, life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and a company-matched pension plan.Employer Contact InformationRyan RobinsonDirector, Talent AcquisitionPhone: +1 (416) 641-3427

jobs.desc: Req Id: 432078Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.SummaryWe are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to help power Bell’s groundbreaking national AI Fabric program—an ambitious, first of its kind initiative that will position Canada as a global leader in Sovereign AI. This program is building a secure, high performance, coast to coast AI compute fabric that will accelerate innovation, strengthen national technological independence, and enable the next generation of AI driven services. In this role, you will design and shape the electrical backbone of advanced data centres that support massive GPU clusters, mission critical AI workloads, and the most demanding digital infrastructure in the country. This is a rare opportunity to contribute to a high impact national mission while applying deep technical expertise to systems that will define the future of Canadian AI capability.Key ResponsibilitiesLead the design, review, and optimization of electrical systems for new data centre builds, expansions, and retrofits.Develop single line diagrams, load calculations, power distribution layouts, and protection coordination studies.Evaluate and plan electrical infrastructure including MV/LV switchgear, UPS systems, generators, PDUs, RPPs, grounding, and redundancy configurations (N, N+1, 2N, 2N+1).Collaborate with architects, mechanical engineers, facility operations teams, and external partners to ensure designs meet performance, safety, and compliance requirements.Participate in site assessments, capacity planning, and operational audits to determine infrastructure readiness and alignment with design standards.Provide technical guidance on procurement specifications for electrical equipment and ensure vendor solutions meet engineering requirements.Support commissioning efforts including FAT, SAT, and integrated systems testing.Identify electrical risks and propose design improvements to increase resiliency, efficiency, and scalability.Maintain up to date documentation, including design packages, operational procedures, and as built drawings.Contribute to long term infrastructure planning aligned with organizational growth and emerging compute workloads (AI/ML, HPC, GPU clusters).Critical QualificationsBachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering; P.Eng or eligibility for professional licensure preferred.5–10+ years of experience in electrical design for mission critical facilities (data centres, telecom, industrial power systems).Strong understanding of power distribution, emergency/backup systems, UPS technologies, and switchgear operation.Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (CSA, OESC, IEEE, NEC/NFPA, TIA 942).Experience with high density and high availability environments (AI compute, GPU clusters) is an asset.Proficiency with design and modeling tools (AutoCAD, Revit, ETAP, SKM, or similar).Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to collaborate across engineering, operations, and vendor teams.Strong analytical and problem solving abilities with a focus on reliability, safety, and operational excellence.Preferred QualificationsExperience supporting operational teams in troubleshooting or planning electrical maintenance activities.Knowledge of energy optimization strategies, power usage effectiveness (PUE), and sustainability initiatives.Background in planning and supporting large scale infrastructure deployments.Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.Additional InformationPosition Type: ManagementJob Status: Regular - Full TimeJob Location: Canada : Ontario : Mississauga || Canada : Alberta : Calgary || Canada : Alberta : Edmonton || Canada : British Columbia : Vancouver || Canada : Ontario : Toronto || Canada : Quebec : Montreal || Canada : Saskatchewan : ReginaWork Arrangement: HybridApplication Deadline: 09/04/2026For work arrangements that are ‘Hybrid’, successful candidates must be based in Canada and report to a set Bell office for a minimum of 3 days a week. Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, Bell offers flexibility in work hours based on the business needs.Please apply directly online to be considered for this role. Applications through email will not be accepted.We know that caring for our team members is at the heart of a healthy, positive and thriving workplace. As part of our team, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive compensation package that includes a competitive salary and a wide range of benefits to support the well-being of you and your family. jobs.desc: Location: Toronto Onsite 5x/weekDuration: 12 months + extensionsRate: 30 - 45/hrWhy: Expected VacancyWe may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, or selection of potential applicants for this position.Required Skills & Experience- 2-3+ year(s) mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)• Technical procedure writing and execution experience for SOP/MOP/EOPs• Experience with building management systems (EPMS)• Experience as an equipment technician performing inspections and break fix for equipment (e.g. generators, UPS, AHU, chillers, pumps...etc.)+• Ability to work 12-hour shifts, including night shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include weekends and/or holidays.Job DescriptionInsight Global is looking for multiple Critical Environment Technicians to work for one of our largest technology customers. You will help to maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our customer's datacenters up and running. This could be anything from performing basic monitoring and inspection, performing various types of maintenance, participating in equipment troubleshooting, enforcing all safety and security requirements, and developing methods of operating procedures (MOPs) and standard operating procedures (SOPs).Critical Environment Culture• Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures are met, to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance to applicable Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations, and [clients] requirements.• Recognizes safe versus unsafe working conditions and responds accordingly (e.g., stop/pause tasks, stand down vendors where necessary). Escalates immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed and promotes a safe working culture to empower other team members. Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs.Equipment and Systems Maintenance• Processes method statement of work (MSOW) documents. Coordinates activities and associated schedules with contractors. Performs inspections of equipment in a facility. Participates in testing and commissioning activities. Advises engineer partners or project management colleagues on project scope process or execution methodology. Presents for review and approval MSOW in their area of responsibility.• Prepares and submits reports as assigned following preexisting scripts and templates, or using ad hoc methods required to support trending and analysis (e.g., Root Cause Analysis [RCA] reports) and may review prior reports delivered by less experienced team members.• Performs various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs for multiple disciplines and multiple equipment types of increasing complexity with no supervision, while serving as a subject matter expert for one discipline - in consideration of Task Hazard Analysis (THA), Method Statement of Work (MSOW), or varying permit requirements. Communicates and/or escalates maintenance activities per established process and procedure. Prioritizes maintenance activities as required and/or appropriate. jobs.title: Director, Power Procurement and Real Estate | Directeur de l'approvisionnement en énergie et de l'immobilier
jobs.desc:
Do you have proven success in leading high-stakes contract negotiations, navigating complex commercial agreements, and handling critical business data with utmost discretion?
Do you have the data-driven rigor and advanced modeling skills required to present clear, persuasive business cases to top-level executives?

About us

eStruxture Data Centers is an award-winning company and the largest Canadian-owned data center provider with locations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, and Calgary. Our solutions are designed to give customers more: more locations, more capacity, more connections that enable them to run modern, demanding enterprise applications, and offer their business the control to rapidly scale in response to unpredictable changes in business processes. eStruxture provides access to an ecosystem to almost 850 customers that trust and depend on our infrastructure and customer support, including carriers, cloud providers, media content, financial services, and enterprise customers. eStruxture offers colocation, bandwidth, security and support services to customers across Canada in its 16 carrier and cloud-neutral facilities.

Everything starts with our dedicated and talented team. As an award-winning industry leader, our data centers help our customers improve network connectivity, redundancy, and uptime, scale up or down, increase cost savings, and provide a high level of physical security. This would be unachievable without the people of eStruxture.

About the role

The Director, Power Procurement and Real Estate leading the real estate and power activity required to fuel the company's national data center expansion. As the primary architect of our national energy roadmap, the Director, Power Procurement and Real Estate will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of grid interconnection, utility partnerships, and energy sourcing across Canadian provinces. In this strategic role, you will source, evaluate, and acquire high-potential greenfield and brownfield sites to fuel our rapid infrastructure expansion across current and emerging markets.

What You’ll Own

Site Selection and Land Acquisition

Lead the identification and acquisition of land and power end-to-end
Build relationships, negotiate purchase agreements, options, power purchase agreements
Manage power expenses, power billing strategy and long-term power outlook
Manage the holistic due diligence process, including zoning, environmental assessments, and geotechnical studies, alongside load analysis and grid feasibility.
Partner with legal to navigate municipal zoning and land-use bylaws to ensure speed to market while maintaining positive community and government relations.

Grid Strategy and Interconnection

Lead the negotiation and execution of grid interconnection agreements with provincial utilities Secure substation capacity and on-site power generation to meet site energization milestones.
Conduct load analysis and feasibility studies before capital is committed to land acquisitions.

Energy Sourcing and PPA Origination

Lead the end-to-end negotiation of utility-scale Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs).
Oversee participation in wholesale electricity markets to optimize energy rates and participate in demand-response programs.

Regulatory Affairs, Advocacy & Leadership

Represent the company at provincial regulatory hearings and industry conferences to influence energy policy and rate structures.
Provide internal thought leadership on power trends and strategy.

Supply Chain Execution & Cross-Functional Alignment

On-Time Delivery & Inventory Strategy: Oversee delivery schedules for all critical equipment to guarantee on-time arrival for a rapidly expanding portfolio. Develop and execute a comprehensive inventory strategy, allocating assets across sites to align seamlessly with construction sequencing.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Construction, Operations, and Finance leadership to align procurement strategies with aggressive site expansion goals.

What you bring

Experience

5+ years in senior roles including investment banking / M&A, consulting, energy procurement, utilities, or heavy industrial power systems
Experience in the data center, colocation, telecom, cloud, managed services, infrastructure, or broader B2B technology sectors is an asset
Deep knowledge or willingness to learn Canadian electricity markets (AESO, IESO, HQ, BC Hydro) and wholesale market participation.
Experience supporting executives and cross-functional teams with data-driven recommendations.

Education/Certification/Designation

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business or a related field considered.

Skills & Technical Knowledge

Ability to use data-driven insights to influence the CEO and Board.
Proven track record of negotiating and closing high-value, long-term commercial contracts.
Comfortable handling sensitive or confidential information during PPA and land acquisition negotiations.
Strong commercial acumen paired with analytical rigor and sound judgment.
Ability to connect disparate data points and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.
Ability to operate at both a strategic and tactical level, with strong attention to detail.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills.
Strong communication skills and the ability to present clearly to senior leadership.
Strong organizational, project management, and change management capabilities.
Advanced Excel skills and strong financial modeling capability.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

Working Conditions

The role has standard working conditions in an office environment with a regular workweek schedule from Monday to Friday. Due to the nature of the role, the incumbent must be able to meet tight deadlines, handle pressure and manage stress.

Ready to make an impact?

If you’re looking for a role where your expertise and leadership will directly influence the growth of a fast-moving company — we’d love to hear from you.

***

Avez-vous une expérience démontrée en négociation de contrats complexes, en gestion d'ententes commerciales stratégiques et en traitement confidentiel de données commerciales sensibles?

Possédez-vous de solides compétences en analyse et en modélisation financière, ainsi que de l'expérience dans la présentation d'analyses de rentabilité à la haute direction?

Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, poursuivez votre lecture.

À propos d’eStruxture

Les centres de données eStruxture est une entreprise primée et le plus grand fournisseur canadien de centres de données avec des sites à Montréal, Toronto, Vancouver et Calgary. Nos solutions sont conçues pour donner plus à nos clients : plus d'emplacements, plus de capacité, plus de connexions qui leur permettent d'exécuter des applications d'entreprise modernes et exigeantes, et d'offrir à leur entreprise le contrôle nécessaire pour s'adapter rapidement aux changements imprévisibles des processus d'affaires. eStruxture donne accès à un écosystème à près de 850 clients qui font confiance et dépendent de notre infrastructure et de notre soutien à la clientèle, y compris des opérateurs, des fournisseurs de nuages informatiques, des contenus médiatiques, des services financiers et des entreprises. eStruxture offre des services de colocation, de bande passante, de sécurité et de soutien à ses clients partout au Canada dans ses 16 installations neutres à l'égard des opérateurs et des nuages informatiques.

Tout commence avec notre équipe dévouée et talentueuse. En tant que leader reconnu du secteur, nos centres de données aident nos clients à améliorer la connectivité, la redondance et le temps de fonctionnement de leur réseau, à augmenter ou à réduire leur capacité, à réaliser des économies et à assurer un niveau élevé de sécurité physique. Tout cela serait impossible sans les collaborateurs
d'eStruxture.

À propos du poste

Le Directeur de l'approvisionnement en énergie et de l'immobilier dirige les activités immobilières et énergétiques nécessaires à l'expansion nationale des centres de données de l'entreprise. En tant que principal architecte de notre feuille de route énergétique nationale, le directeur de l'approvisionnement en énergie et de l'immobilier pilotera l'ensemble du cycle de vie des raccordements au réseau, des partenariats avec les services publics et de l'approvisionnement en énergie dans toutes les provinces canadiennes. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous serez chargé(e) de rechercher, d’évaluer et d’acquérir des sites vierges et désaffectés à fort potentiel afin de soutenir l’expansion rapide de nos infrastructures sur les marchés actuels et émergents.

Responsabilités principals

Sélection des sites et acquisition foncière

Diriger de bout en bout l’identification et l’acquisition des terrains et des sources d’énergie
Établir des relations, négocier des contrats d’achat, des options et des contrats d’achat d’électricité
Gérer les dépenses liées à l’électricité, la stratégie de facturation de l’électricité et les perspectives à long terme en matière d’approvisionnement électrique
Gérer l’ensemble du processus de diligence raisonnable, y compris le zonage, les études d’impact environnemental et les études géotechniques, ainsi que l’analyse de la charge et la faisabilité du raccordement au réseau.
Collaborer avec le service juridique pour naviguer parmi les règlements municipaux de zonage et d’aménagement du territoire afin de garantir une mise sur le marché rapide tout en entretenant de bonnes relations avec la communauté et les pouvoirs publics.

Stratégie de raccordement au réseau et interconnexion

Diriger la négociation et la signature des accords d’interconnexion au réseau avec les services publics provinciaux. Garantir la capacité des postes de transformation et la production d’électricité sur site afin de respecter les étapes clés de la mise sous tension du site.
Réaliser des analyses de charge et des études de faisabilité avant d’engager des dépenses d’investissement dans l’acquisition de terrains.

Approvisionnement énergétique et conclusion de contrats d’achat d’électricité (CAE)

Diriger la négociation de bout en bout des contrats d’achat d’électricité (CAE) à grande échelle.
Superviser la participation aux marchés de gros de l’électricité afin d’optimiser les tarifs énergétiques et de participer à des programmes de réponse à la demande.

Affaires réglementaires, défense des intérêts et leadership

Représenter l’entreprise lors d’audiences réglementaires provinciales et de conférences sectorielles afin d’influencer la politique énergétique et les structures tarifaires.
Assurer un leadership éclairé en interne sur les tendances et la stratégie en matière d’énergie.

Exécution de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et coordination interfonctionnelle

Respect des délais de livraison et stratégie de gestion des stocks : superviser les calendriers de livraison de tous les équipements critiques afin de garantir leur arrivée dans les délais pour un portefeuille en expansion rapide. Élaborer et mettre en œuvre une stratégie globale de gestion des stocks, en répartissant les actifs entre les différents sites pour s’aligner parfaitement sur le calendrier de construction.
Coordination interfonctionnelle : travailler en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de la construction, de l’exploitation et des finances afin d’aligner les stratégies d’approvisionnement sur les objectifs ambitieux d’expansion des sites.

Profil recherché

Expérience

Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions à responsabilités, idéalement en banque d'investissement, en fusions et acquisitions (F&A), en conseil, en approvisionnement énergétique, dans les services publics ou les systèmes d'alimentation électrique destinés à l'industrie lourde.
